Once upon a time there was a wealthy man. He had a big house and lots of toys. But he was not happy. Every day he would sit in his house and feel sad.
One day, he decided to go for a walk. He started to climb a hill. The sun was shining and the birds were singing. The man began to smile.
As he climbed higher and higher, he got to a special spot at the top of the hill. There he sat down and hummed a song. The more he sang, the happier he felt.
The wealthy man climbed down the hill with a big smile on his face. He had never felt so happy! He thanked the birds for their lovely song. From that day on, the wealthy man was much happier.

Once upon a time, there lived a patient old man. Every day he tended to his farm, taking care of the animals and growing the crops. One day, he noticed someone sneaking around his farm. 
"Who's there?" yelled the old man. 
But to his surprise, no one answered. He slowly made his way around the farm, calling out for anyone there. Suddenly, from behind the misty trees, a voice said, 
"I'm here! I was trying to steal some of your things!" 
The old man was not angry. He was patient and simply said, 
"Stealing is wrong. It is better to work hard to earn what you need." 
The young man listened carefully and nodded his head. He thanked the old man and ran off, vowing never to steal again. 
The old man smiled, knowing he had done the right thing. He continued tending to his farm, and mist soon faded away. The old man had learned a valuable lesson: being patient can lead to understanding.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One evening, she went outside to play with her pink ball. She was having so much fun bouncing it around when she heard a noise. 
"Hello?" she called out. 
"Hello, Lily," said her neighbor, Mrs. Johnson. "What a pretty ball you have there." 
"Thank you," said Lily. "Do you want to play with me?" 
"I would love to," said Mrs. Johnson. And so, they played together until the sun went down and it was time for Lily to go to bed. She fell asleep with her pink ball beside her, happy to have made a new friend.

Once upon a time there was a lion. He was big and strong with a loud voice and bright yellow fur. Every day he would wake up early and roar up to the sky with all of his might, which everyone could hear.
Some of the animals living in the nearby forest were scared of the roaring, but one brave little songbird enjoyed it. She found the lion's roar lively and full of energy and eventually she started singing her own song in response.
The lion was happy to hear the little bird. He would roar and the bird would sing. And soon all of the other animals, from elephants to monkeys and even more songbirds, started joining in. The noise was happy and loud with everyone singing and roaring and playing together.
The lion and his animal friends had lots of fun making music together. Their song would go on until the sun went down and a peaceful nighttime win over the forest.

Once upon a time, there lived a generous clay. The clay could move but it liked to freeze in the sunshine. One day, a little boy saw the clay. He was so excited and wanted to take it home with him. The clay wanted to help the boy too, so it let the boy take it home.
The little boy put the clay in his backyard. Every day, he would play with the clay. He would make shapes and pretend they were animals. He would try to find ways to make the clay move too.
One morning, the boy woke up and saw something special. The clay was moving! It was still freezing, but now the clay could move around.
The little boy was so happy. He hugged the clay and thanked it for being so generous. From then on, the clay would always move and freeze with the little boy in the backyard. They had lots of fun together!

Nina was a brave little girl. She loved exploring and finding new things. One day, she was playing in the woods when she came across a swamp.
At first, Nina was very curious. She wanted to know what was inside the swamp. But then she felt a little bit frightened. She took a few steps back and hesitated.
Finally, Nina made a decision and grabbed hold of a nearby tree branch. She began to move closer and closer to the swamp until she was right on the edge.
Nina took a deep breath and then she opened the swamp. Inside, she found a treasure! There were all kinds of shiny gems and valuable items lying around. Nina was so happy that she had been brave enough to overcome her fear.

Once upon a time there lived a hard hunter. He lived in the woods and hunted game every day. One day he decided to go on an adventure like he had never done before. He packed his bags and off he went, determined to find the end of the woods.
When he arrived at the edge of the woods he saw a big, open field. He was so excited to explore. He walked across the field and realized that he had been walking for a long time. He was beginning to get tired, but he kept going until he spotted the end of the field.
He shouted, "Yay, I've reached the end!" Suddenly, a voice called out from behind him. It was a small voice. When he turned around, he saw a little girl. She was only three years old.
"What's at the end?" she asked.
The hunter smiled. "I don't know," he said. "But that's all part of the adventure!" Then he said goodbye, and continued on his journey. 
The little girl watched him go until he disappeared around the corner. And that was the end of the hunter's big adventure.

Once upon a time there was a baby called Andy. He loved playing with his favourite blanket. It was fancy, with little stars and moons on it.
One day his mommy said with a smile, "Andy, we are going to raise your blanket up in the air!"
Andy was so excited to see what would happen. He could feel the blanket becoming lighter and lighter. Then, all of a sudden, Andy was lifted off the ground. He squealed with delight as he flew through the air, the blanket swishing around him.
Mommy had raised Andy high in the air on the blanket! It was like a fancy special magic ride! Andy laughed and laughed as he spun around. All of his family and friends clapped with joy to see him so happy.
Andy flew higher and higher and just when he thought he was reaching the sky, he fell gently down to the ground.
The magic was over, and Andy was sad - until his mommy said, "Who wants to go round again?" Andy shouted with joy, "Me, me!"

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go to the beach and play in the sand. One day, while she was playing, she found a big net. She was so happy and cheerful that she started jumping up and down.
Her friend, Timmy, came over and asked, "What did you find, Lily?" 
"I found a big net!" she said, still cheerful. "Let's examine it together!"
They looked at the net closely and noticed that it had some holes in it. "Maybe we can fix it," Timmy suggested. They worked together to mend the holes and soon the net was as good as new. 
Lily and Timmy used the net to catch some fish in the ocean. They were so excited and cheerful when they caught their first fish. "This is so much fun!" Lily exclaimed. 
From that day on, Lily and Timmy would always bring the net to the beach and examine it to make sure it was still in good condition. They would catch fish and have cheerful adventures together.

Once there was an energetic girl called Amy. She was restless and always wanted to move. One day Amy's mom took her to the park. She made Amy do different exercises like running, jumping and hopping. Amy was excited about it and enjoyed every moment of it.
After a few hours, Amy got tired and wanted to take a break. Mom asked her to sit down and to take a rest. Amy was patient for a few minutes and then she got restless again. She wanted to play more and wanted to run fast. Mom knew why Amy was so eager and she suggested they play a new game, she called it Strike.
In this game, Amy was supposed to run and throw a ball up in the air and then quickly come back and catch it. Amy had great fun and found it a bit challenging. After a few rounds of Strike, Amy was exhausted and glad to be done with the exercise.

Once upon a time, there was a good boy named Timmy. Timmy always listened to his mommy and daddy. He was obedient. 
One day, Timmy's mommy gave him a present. It was a toy car. Timmy loved his present so much that he played with it all day long. 
But then, it was time for Timmy to go to bed. Before he went to sleep, his mommy told him to wash his hands and face. Timmy went to the bathroom and washed his hands and face very well. 
After he finished washing, Timmy went to bed with his present next to him. He fell asleep with a big smile on his face. The end.

Jemma was a big girl, three years old and very brave. She wanted to play with her friends at the park, but it was all so dirty. Everywhere she looked the grass was mucky and the sand was gritty. But Jemma didn't give in.
Jemma decided to make her own game. She used a stick to mark a goal in the sand. She and her friends took turns taking shots at the goal by throwing pebbles. Jemma cheered every time her friends made a shot.
The game was going well until a big, mean cat came by. It jump over the goal and even tried to take the stick. Jemma had to be brave and take a stand. She clapped her hands and yelled so loud at the cat that it ran away in a fright.
Jemma and her friends cheered. They were so proud of their brave leader. The game was able to continue and the goal was made even stronger. The cat never came back and Jemma was proud of her goal. The game was a success and everyone had great fun.

Once upon a time, there was a big house with a lot of rooms. The house was very tall and had a strong structure. One day, a clumsy mouse got inside the house and started running around. The people in the house saw the mouse and tried to catch it, but it was too fast. 
Then, a little girl came and said she could show them how to catch the mouse. She took a piece of cheese and put it in a trap. The mouse smelled the cheese and went inside the trap. The little girl was very happy to have caught the mouse and showed it to everyone. 
From that day on, the people in the house made sure to keep the doors closed so no more clumsy mice could get inside. And the little girl was very proud of herself for showing everyone how to catch the mouse.

Anna liked to go to the park with her mom and dad. She liked to see the ducks and the swans in the pond. She liked to feed them bread and watch them swim.
One day, she saw a swan that was not lively. It was lying on the grass and did not move. Anna felt sad for the swan. She asked her mom and dad what was wrong with it.
Her mom and dad said the swan was hurt. It had a hook in its wing. The hook was from a fisher who was not careful. They said they would try to fix the swan and make it better.
They called a helper who worked with animals. The helper came with a big net and a box. He was gentle with the swan. He took the hook out of its wing and put some cream on it. He put the swan in the box and said he would take it to a safe place.
Anna was happy that the helper would fix the swan. She hoped the swan would be lively again soon. She said goodbye to the swan and thanked the helper. She gave the swan a kiss and a hug. She said she would come back to the park and look for the swan when it was well.

Alice was a young girl living at home with her mom and dad. Every day, her mom and dad went to the university to learn and study. Alice loved watching them, but she couldn't go with them. One day, her mom and dad told her that when she grew up and was big enough, she could go to the university too!
Alice was excited and she asked many questions to learn more about college. Her mom explained that university was a fun place to learn and make new friends. She said that it wouldn't be easy, but with hard work, Alice would return home successful.
Alice soon forgot about university until one day her mom and dad both graduated. They had worked so hard and were now ready to celebrate their success. Alice was happy but she started to think about the future and wondered if one day she would return to university too.
Alice was not sure if the university would be easy, but she was determined to work hard. She knew if she stayed focused, she would be able to return just like her mom and dad.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Mia. Mia loved her jewelry. She had a big box full of pretty things. She liked to wear them all day. But at night, she had to sleep.
One day, Mia met a talking cat named Tom. Tom was a tough cat, but he was nice. Tom said, "Hi, Mia! I like your jewelry. Can I wear some too?" Mia said, "Yes, Tom. You can wear my jewelry, but we have to give it back before we sleep."
So, Mia and Tom played together. They wore the jewelry and had fun. They pretended to be kings and queens. They laughed and danced. But soon, the sun went down, and it was time for bed.
Mia said, "Tom, we must give back the jewelry now. It's time to sleep." Tom gave back the jewelry and said, "Thank you, Mia. I had fun today." They put the jewelry back in the box and went to sleep. Mia and Tom were happy, and they had sweet dreams.

Bob wanted a new boot but he was spoiled. His parents said that he could have anything he wanted as long as he put on his best dress. 
So Bob went to his room and put on his special dress. It was red with polka dots and it sparkled in the light. He twirled around so everyone could see how lovely it looked. 
Bob then went downstairs and asked his parents for his new boot. His mom and dad smiled and said it was fine. They walked him to the store and showed him all the different kinds of boots. 
Bob found his favorite one right away. It was yellow and had stars on it. He put it on his foot and it fit perfectly. Bob was so excited that he instantly started to skip home.
His mom and dad were so happy to see him so excited. They were glad that they were able to give him something he really wanted. He was so spoiled! From then on, Bob would always wear his special dress and his new yellow boot.

One day, a large cat was walking outside. The cat was looking for something to catch. Suddenly, the cat noticed a watch. It was shiny and sparkled in the sun. The cat wanted to catch the watch so it could have something special.
The cat ran as fast as it could and managed to catch the watch. The cat was so proud of itself. It decided to take it home as a surprise for its owner.
The cat showed its owner the large watch. The owner was so happy that the cat had managed to catch it. They gave the cat lots of cuddles and praised it for being so clever.
The cat and its owner enjoyed playing with the watch together. And after that, the cat was always proud when it was out looking for things to catch.

One day, two little girls were playing in the park. They had a banana with them. They were being careless and dropped it on the ground. They looked at the banana sadly. They wanted to eat it but it wasn't okay anymore.
Suddenly, someone special arrived. It was their Mommy! She saw the banana and realized what had happened. She was wonderful and managed to make it better. She peeled the banana and then cut it into pieces. Now it looked yummy.
The two little girls were delighted. They ate the banana pieces, being careful not to drop any. They were so happy that their Mommy was able to manage the situation. She was the best Mommy in the world!

Once upon a time, there was a little star. The star was very happy because it could glow in the sky. One day, a big storm came and the star was scared. The storm was very loud and the wind was blowing hard. But the star was strong and it kept glowing. The storm passed and the star felt brilliant. It was proud of itself for being brave during the scary storm. And from that day on, the star knew it could always glow brightly, even during the biggest storms.

One day, a plane was flying high above. It was going to work and it felt excited. As it flew above, it saw something. It saw a little girl near a pond. She looked very guilty. The plane flew closer and saw that she had a bucket and she was picking something from the pond. The plane noticed that she was picking up tiny little fish and putting them in the bucket. 
The plane was confused. Why was the girl taking the fish? Suddenly, the plane noticed that there were two cats near the pond. The plane realized that the girl was taking the fish to feed the cats. It felt happy to know that the girl was taking care of the cats. 
The plane watched as the girl ran to the cats and dropped the fish near them. The cats were very excited and they quickly ate the fish. The plane was happy to know that the girl was trying to help the cats and it flew away feeling very pleased.

Once upon a time, there was a big garage. It was where Daddy parked his car. One day, Mommy told Daddy that they needed more space in the garage. Daddy said he would increase the size of the garage. 
The next day, Daddy got to work. He used his tools to make the garage bigger. He worked very hard all day. When he was done, Mommy was very happy. She said, "Wow, Daddy! The garage is so much bigger now!" 
That night, Daddy went to bed feeling very alert. He was happy that he could make Mommy happy by increasing the size of the garage. He knew that they would have more space for their things now. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in her yard. One day, she saw a tall hedge in her yard. It was so tall that she couldn't see over it.
Lily went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, I want to pack a picnic and eat it by the tall hedge." Her mommy said, "That's a great idea, Lily. Let's pack some sandwiches and juice."
So, Lily and her mommy packed a picnic and went outside to eat by the tall hedge. As they were eating, they heard a voice say, "Hello there!" It was a little bird sitting on a branch of the tall hedge.
Lily said, "Hi little bird! Do you want to join us for our picnic?" The little bird said, "Yes, please!" They all had a great time eating and talking by the tall hedge. And from that day on, Lily and the little bird became best friends.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play outside and look at the flowers. One day, she was playing with her friends when she fell down and hurt her knee. She cried and her friends came to see what happened.
"Are you okay, Lily?" asked her friend Sarah.
"It hurts," replied Lily, pointing to her knee.
Sarah looked at Lily's knee and said, "Don't worry, it's just a little scrape. You'll be charming again in no time."
Lily smiled and felt better. She got up and continued to play with her friends. They all had fun together and Lily forgot about her knee. From that day on, Lily knew that even when she fell down, her friends would be there to help her and make her feel better.

Tom and Lily are twins. They like to play in their house. Sometimes they play with their toys, sometimes they play with their dog, and sometimes they play on the stair.
One day, they decide to play on the stair. They take their pillows and blankets and make a fort. They pretend they are in a castle and they are the king and the queen. They enjoy their game very much.
But their mom is working in her room. She needs to be quiet. She does not like the noise that Tom and Lily make on the stair. She tells them to stop and play somewhere else.
Tom and Lily are sad. They do not want to leave their fort. They do not want to make their mom angry. They think of a way to play on the stair and be quiet.
They find some books and crayons. They sit on the stair and read and draw. They whisper to each other and giggle softly. They enjoy their new game too.
Their mom is happy. She can work in her room and be quiet. She is proud of Tom and Lily for being good and creative. She gives them a hug and a kiss and tells them she loves them.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Mia. Mia loved her room because it had a big bookshelf. The bookshelf was full of colorful books. Mia liked to read these books every day.
One day, Mia was very tired. She wanted to find a book to read before she went to bed. Mia looked at the bookshelf and picked out a book with a pretty cover. She sat down and started to read the book.
As Mia read the book, she began to feel more and more sleepy. She read and read until she reached the end of the story. Mia was so tired that she closed the book and put it back on the bookshelf. Then, she went to bed and had sweet dreams.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat grapes because they were sweet and yummy. One day, her mom gave her some grapes to eat, but Lily refused to eat them because they had seeds in them.
Later that day, Lily went to the park to play. She saw a graceful swan swimming in the pond. The swan was so pretty and Lily wanted to touch it, but her mom told her not to because the swan might get scared and fly away.
As they were leaving the park, Lily's mom offered her some more grapes to eat. This time, Lily happily ate them because her mom had taken out all the seeds. She felt so full and happy, and she even said "thank you" to her mom for being so kind.

It was a sunny day. The sun was shining brightly in the sky. All the birds were chirping happily.
A little boy was walking along the street. He saw something shiny on the ground. He bent down to pick it up. It was a gray banana!
He was so happy to have found it. He put it in his pocket and kept walking. When he looked up, he saw his house in the distance. Its windows were shining in the sunlight.
He ran to the house and opened the door. He set the gray banana on the kitchen table. Then he smiled and went outside to play.
The sun was still shining brightly, and the birds were still chirping. The little boy was so happy that he had found the gray banana. It may have been small, but it was special to him—it was his special find!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in the bathtub and splash water all around. One day, she turned the faucet on and water started to flow. But when she tried to turn it off, it wouldn't stop. She called out to her mommy, "Mommy, the water won't stop!"
Mommy came running and saw the faucet was broken. She said, "Don't worry, Lily. We can fix it." Mommy found a flexible hose and used it to stop the water from flowing. Then she turned the faucet off and said, "All done!"
Lily was happy that the water stopped, but she was sad that she couldn't play in the bathtub anymore. So, mommy said, "Let's make a game out of it. We can seat your toys on the edge of the tub and pretend they're on a boat in the water." Lily loved the idea and they played together until it was time for bed.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Benny. Benny loved to hop and play all day long. One day, Benny saw a shiny piece of jewelry on the ground. He picked it up and put it on his neck. He felt so happy and proud of himself. 
But then, he saw his friends, the squirrels, looking weak and sad. Benny realized that he had been selfish and didn't share his jewelry with his friends. So, he decided to bow his head and apologize to his friends. 
From that day on, Benny learned that sharing is important and it's not nice to make others feel weak or left out. He made sure to always share his toys and treats with his friends, and they all lived happily ever after.

Tom and Anna are friends. They like to play and eat together. One day, they go to the park with their moms. They see a big truck with a picture of a waffle on it. They want to try a waffle.
"Mom, can we have a waffle, please?" Tom asks.
"Me too, me too!" Anna says.
Their moms smile and nod. They walk to the truck and wait in line. The man in the truck is very busy. He makes many waffles for many people. He is humble and kind. He says hello and thank you to everyone.
When it is Tom and Anna's turn, he asks them, "What kind of waffle do you want? I have chocolate, strawberry, and vanilla."
Tom and Anna look at each other. They do not know what to answer. They like all the kinds of waffles. They think hard.
"Um, can we have one of each?" Tom says.
"Yeah, one of each!" Anna says.
The man in the truck laughs. He says, "Sure, why not? You are very brave and curious. Here you go, one chocolate, one strawberry, and one vanilla waffle. Enjoy!"
Tom and Anna are very happy. They say thank you to the man and take their waffles. They sit on a bench and share their waffles. They taste each kind and say which one they like best.
"I like chocolate best. It is sweet and yummy," Tom says.
"I like strawberry best. It is pink and fruity," Anna says.
"I like vanilla best. It is white and creamy," the man in the truck says. He comes to the bench and sits with them. He has a waffle too.
Tom and Anna are surprised. They did not see him come. They smile and offer him some of their waffles.
"Thank you, that is very nice of you. But I have my own waffle. I like to eat one every day. It makes me happy," the man says.
Tom and Anna nod. They understand. They like to eat waffles too. They make them happy. They finish their waffles and lick their fingers. They say goodbye to the man and thank him again. They hug their moms and go home. They had a fun and tasty day. They are good friends.

Once there was a healthy boy. He was big and strong and liked to play. One day he wanted to play catch, but he didn't have a ball. He asked around, but no one had one to lend.
The boy thought about it for a minute, then he had an idea. He ran to his neighbor's house and knocked on the door. Luckily, the neighbor had a ball to lend. She gave it to the boy and he thanked her very much.
Now the boy could play catch. He ran outside with his new ball, full of excitement. He invited all the kids in his neighborhood to join him. Everyone had so much fun playing catch and being healthy.
The boy was very thankful that his neighbor had been kind enough to lend him the ball. He made sure to thank her many times. Everywhere he went, he always found someone to lend him a ball so he could keep playing and staying healthy.

The sun was shining brightly one morning when Max decided to explore the creek near his house. He grabbed his bucket and waded into the cool water. Max was having so much fun, splashing and playing.
Suddenly, Max saw something in the water ahead of him. It was a sign. He floated closer and read the sign. It said 'Danger - Do Not Enter'. Max had learned about dangers, and so he backed away from the creek.
Max was sad but he knew it was better to be safe than sorry. He thought of a plan. Max decided to go home, get his binoculars and then he could watch the creek from a safe distance.
Max eventually made it back home but he was careful to keep his distance from the creek. He set up his binoculars and zoomed in on the creek. Through the binoculars he could see the dangerous things that might be lurking in the water.
He was glad he didn't try to go closer. For now, Max will just have to keep watching the creek from a safe spot.

Once upon a time there were two friends, John and Ann. They went outside to play in the cold weather.
John said to Ann, "Let's crawl together!"
Ann said, "No, I want to do some work. I'm too cold to crawl!"
John didn't want to listen. He kept crawling and said, "C'mon Ann, it's so much fun!"
Ann stayed still and said, "No, I'm cold and want to do something else!"
John got really angry. He said, "Fine, I'm going to crawl by myself then!" He crawled away angrily.
But he quickly got cold and lonely. He realized he missed Ann! He crawled back to her and said, "Can we play together now, Ann? I'm sorry I was so mad."
Ann smiled, and said, "Yes, let's play together!"
They crawled back to the house, laughing and having fun!

Once upon a time, there was a sheep named Baa. Baa had lots of wool on her body that kept her warm. One day, a wealthy farmer came to Baa's field and saw her wool. He wanted to take it and sell it for money. Baa didn't want to lose her wool, so she decided to move away from the farmer. She ran and ran until she found a safe place where no one could take her wool. From that day on, Baa was happy and warm with her wool. The end.

Today, Timmy had a lot of fun playing in the park. He laughed and ran and ran, chasing after his friends. But now, it was time to return to the house. Timmy slowly dragged his feet to his bedroom, but it was easy to find his way. He knew exactly where he was going.
When he got to his bedroom, he saw a big box, with a bow on top. He ran to the box and opened it. Inside was all kinds of fun stuff, just for him! He jumped and shouted in excitement, then opened all the things he found.
After playing for a while, Timmy was feeling tired. He put the box away and snuggled up in his bed. He felt so sleepy and easy, it didn't take long for him to drift off to dreamland. 
The next morning, Timmy woke up feeling refreshed. He was ready for another day of play at the park, and he couldn't wait to return and have some more fun.

Once upon a time, there was a little tree who was very anxious. All her friends had leaves and beautiful flowers, but she was the only one without any. Everyday, she worried that no one would want her because she was so different.
But then one day, the wind blew over a special root. The little tree was excited, so she quickly reached down to pick it up. She knew it was the perfect thing to attach to her branches so she held onto it tight. 
The root was filled with power and soon enough, beautiful leaves started to appear on the tree. The little tree was so happy - she had never been so happy before! All her worries were gone and she thanked the wind for bringing her this special root. 
From then on, the little tree was not anxious anymore. She was so proud of her beautiful leaves and all her friends were so happy that she now looked the same as them.
The end.

Once there was an elderly person who loved to take walks in the park. One day, he was taking his regular stroll when he spotted a bird, flying around in the sky. All of a sudden, the bird dived down and bit the elderly person on the arm. It was surprised by what had happened and started to scream. The elderly person ran away, scared of the bird.
Meanwhile, a young three year old boy was playing nearby and saw what had happened. He saw the bird and spoke to it in a soothing voice. He reached out his hand and the bird flew onto it. He held it gently and the bird calmed down. He looked into the eyes of the bird and saw it was scared.
The little boy carefully brought the bird over to the elderly person and showed it to him. He told the elderly person not to be scared. The elderly person looked at the boy and smiled. The bird flew away and the elderly person thanked the little boy for helping him. From that day onward, the boy always kept an eye out for the elderly person when he took his walks in the park.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl who loved to play in her bedroom. Everyday she would run around, playing with her toys and drawing pictures. But one day, she noticed that her mum and dad were not smiling and frowning a lot.
The little girl was worried and asked her mum why she was so sad. Her mum said she was feeling a bit sick but that she was fine. Still, the little girl wanted to help. So she decided to tidy up the bedroom and make it look nice and clean.
When her mum saw the room, she smiled and said "What a nice job you've done! I feel much better now." She gave the little girl a big hug.
The little girl was so happy that she had made her mum feel better that she jumped up and down in excitement. And ever since then, she always helps tidy up her bedroom so her mum can feel fine.

John was a kind and gentle boy. He always liked to make his friends laugh with silly jokes and games. One day, John and his friends were playing together at the park when they noticed a hang glider in the sky. It was long and colourful, and they began to giggle.
John said, “Let’s see who can jump the highest! Then we can go hang gliding too!” 
His friends agreed, so they all started jumping. But soon, someone started to climb the hang glider’s cable and jump on it!
John cried out, “Wait! That’s our hang glider!”. It was their teacher, Ms. Jones.
Ms. Jones said in a stern voice, “What are you doing? I can’t trust my pupils to be so silly.”
John quickly apologised and told Ms. Jones that he was just trying to show his friends how to hang glider. Ms. Jones replied, “I can see that, but please be more careful next time. Now, off you all go!” 
John and his friends thanked Ms. Jones for understanding and waved goodbye as she took off on the hang glider. From then on, John and his friends made sure to only play silly games when it was safe and without breaking any rules!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Tom. Tom was a fearful boy who didn't like to try new things. One day, Tom and his mom went to a big store. They needed to go up to find Tom's favorite toy. Tom's mom said, "We will take the elevator to go up."
Tom was scared of the elevator. He had never been in one before. He asked his mom, "What if it's too fast?" His mom smiled and said, "Don't worry, it's not fast. I'll hold your hand."
As they walked to the elevator, Tom saw a man load a big box onto a cart. The man pushed the cart into the elevator. Tom's mom held his hand and they went inside too. The elevator went up slowly, just like his mom said. Tom felt safe and happy.
When they got to the top, Tom saw his favorite toy on a shelf. He was so excited! He forgot all about being scared of the elevator. Tom's mom said, "See? The elevator wasn't so bad." Tom nodded and smiled.
From that day on, Tom wasn't fearful of elevators anymore. He learned that trying new things can be fun, especially when his mom was there to hold his hand.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to skip and play outside in the sunshine. One day, she found a yummy-looking case on the ground. She picked it up and shook it, but it didn't make any noise.
Lily decided to take the case home with her. She put it on her shelf and forgot about it for a while. But one day, she remembered the case and decided to open it. Inside, she found something very special - a shiny necklace!
Lily was so happy to have found the necklace in the case. She put it on and skipped around her house, feeling very fancy. From then on, she always remembered to keep an eye out for special cases that might have something yummy inside.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to climb trees in the park. One day, she climbed a tall tree and shouted, "Look how high I am!"
Suddenly, she heard silence. She looked down and saw that her mom was gone. She was scared and started to cry. "Mommy, where are you?" she shouted.
But then she heard a strong voice from below. It was her daddy! "I'm here, Lily. Don't worry, I'll help you down." And he did. From that day on, Lily always climbed trees with her daddy by her side.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his colorful toys. One day, Timmy got sick and had to go to the hospital. He was sad because he couldn't play with his toys anymore.
But then, a kind doctor came to see him. The doctor had a jet on his shirt! The doctor gave Timmy some medicine to heal him. Timmy felt better and was able to go home and play with his colorful toys again. He was so happy!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went outside to pick some fruit from the trees. She saw a big, juicy apple and a small, sweet orange. She wanted to eat them both, but she couldn't carry them all by herself.
Suddenly, she saw her friend Billy walking by. She asked him if he wanted to join her and share the fruit. Billy was scared of climbing the tree, but Lily helped him up. Together, they picked the fruit and sat down to eat it. They were happy they could share and be friends.

Once upon a time, there was a big parade. Lots of people were walking and dancing. They had pretty costumes and funny hats. Suddenly, a man started to shout. He was very loud and it hurt some people's ears. But he was persistent and he kept shouting. The police came and asked him to stop, but he didn't listen. Finally, they took him away and the parade continued.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved watching movies with her family. One day, she went to the movie theater with her mom and dad. They watched a funny movie about a cat and a mouse.
After the movie, they went to get some ice cream. Lily wanted to hold the ice cream by herself, but she was nervous that she might drop it. Her dad said, "Don't worry, Lily. You can do it!" But as she was holding the ice cream, it slipped from her hand and fell on the ground. Lily was sad and thought she had broken the ice cream.
Her mom said, "It's okay, Lily. We can buy another one. But remember, things can break, but it's important to not be nervous and try again." Lily learned that it's okay to make mistakes and that she can always try again.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Mark. Mark was only three years old and loved to play.
One day, Mark was outside looking for things to play with. He found a pot and decided to try and clean it. He found an oat and started scrubbing the pot.
But then his mother called him inside. He felt guilty, so he quickly put the oat down and went inside. 
"Mark, you've been outside for too long", said his mother. 
"But I was cleaning!" said Mark.
His mother smiled and said, "That's nice. But now it's time to come inside and have some lunch." 
Mark smiled and happily followed his mother inside. 
The end.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who loved to study.
She studied her ABC's, numbers, colors and shapes. Every day she studied a bit harder and got smarter.
One day she was studying with her waist up on the chair, when she heard a voice.
It was her brother. He was telling her she was stupid.
She felt sad, because he was saying mean things. But she knew he was wrong.
She put her waist down from the chair and went to talk to him.
She told him that she was smart and studying would help her get smarter.
Her brother changed his mind and said that studying was a fantastic thing to do. He even asked her to help him with his studies too.
She smiled and hugged him.
They then both sat down and started studying together.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play with her toys and her cat, Mittens. One day, Lily's mom gave her a pretty vase. It was shiny and had flowers on it. Lily loved it very much and put it on her dresser. 
That night, Lily was scared of the dark. She saw shadows on her wall that looked like monsters. But then, she saw Mittens waving his tail and she felt better. Mittens jumped up on her dresser and accidentally knocked over the vase! 
Lily was sad that her vase broke, but she knew it was just an accident. She hugged Mittens and went to sleep feeling happy that her cat was there to wave his tail and make her feel better.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily went on a walk with her mommy. They saw lots of flowers, but Lily liked the lilies the most. She picked one and smelled it, but it was smelly! 
"Lily, we can't keep that flower. It's not nice to pick flowers from someone else's garden," said mommy. 
Lily was sad, but she understood. "Can we pack a picnic instead?" she asked. 
"Sure, let's go home and pack some sandwiches," mommy replied. And so, they went home and packed a yummy picnic. They sat outside and enjoyed their lunch while looking at the pretty flowers in their own garden. Lily was happy again. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved playing in her backyard. It was a beautiful place with green grass and colorful flowers. 
One day, Lily's mommy told her that they were going to have a special surprise in the backyard. Lily was very excited and couldn't wait to find out what it was. 
When they got to the backyard, Lily saw a big, shiny new swing set. She was so happy and decided that she would spend all day playing on it. 
As the day went on, Lily realized that the swing set was not just a fun toy, but it also helped her exercise and stay healthy. She was happy that her mommy had decided to surprise her with such a wonderful gift. From then on, Lily spent every day playing in her beautiful backyard with her new swing set.

John lay on the seat of the soft green car. He felt pale and tired. All around him was quiet and plenty of grass. 
John looked down at his heels. The old shoes were scuffed and worn, but he knew he could run with them. He wanted to try and run away from the car, across the grass and feel the warm sun. 
Just then, he spotted a bright red balloon in the distance. He quickly sat up and clapped his hands in excitement. He was determined to get that balloon no matter how far it floated.
John jumped out of the car and raced across the grass. He ran as fast and as hard as his heels could take him, his heart pounding in anticipation. 
Finally, John reached the balloon. He smiled as he caught it in his hands and lay back down in the car, the bright red balloon still in his grip. 
John lay there in happiness, knowing he had accomplished his goal. The wind gently pushed the balloon higher, taking John soaring through the air with it.

Once upon a time, there was a small bug. He had a friend, who was an elderly bug. They liked to play together.
One day, they decided to go to a big tree. The tree had many leaves. They were very happy to play there. The elderly bug said, "I like this tree a lot!"
The small bug and elderly bug played all day. They had so much fun. Then, they went home to rest. They were very tired but happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved chocolate more than anything in the world. One day, her mommy let her have a big piece of chocolate. It was mighty delicious!
But then, Lily started feeling a little funny. Her tummy started hurting and she felt sick. Her mommy told her that too much chocolate can make you feel sick. 
From that day on, Lily learned that she should only have a little bit of chocolate at a time. She still loved it, but she was careful not to eat too much. And every time she had a little bit, she remembered how mighty delicious it was, but also how important it was to not eat too much.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the hot sun. But today, the weather was not so hot. It was cloudy and rainy. Lily was sad because she could not play outside.
Lily's mom had an idea to make her happy. They went to the store to buy decorations. They bought balloons, streamers, and a big banner that said "Happy Birthday". Lily was confused because it was not her birthday. But her mom said they were going to decorate the house to make it look like a party.
Lily helped her mom decorate the house. She put up the balloons and streamers. She was so happy that she forgot about the rainy weather. When they finished decorating, they had a party inside the house. They danced and sang and had so much fun. Lily was no longer sad because she had a fun party inside her house!

Tim and Sam were brothers who liked to play in their room. They had many toys and books and games, but they also liked to try on their parents' clothes. They thought it was fun to wear big hats and coats and shoes and pretend to be different people.
One day, they found a key on the floor. They wondered what it could unlock. They looked around and saw a big trunk in the corner of the room. They had never opened it before. They decided to try the key on the trunk. It fit and they turned it. The trunk unlocked with a click.
They opened the trunk and saw many unusual clothes inside. They were colorful and shiny and had strange patterns and shapes. They were very different from the clothes they usually wore. They were curious and excited. They took out some of the clothes and put them on. They laughed and danced and made funny noises.
"Look at me, I'm a king!" Tim said, wearing a purple robe and a golden crown.
"And I'm a clown!" Sam said, wearing a red nose and a polka-dot suit.
They had so much fun that they did not hear their mom calling them for lunch. She came to their room and saw them in the unusual clothes. She was surprised and angry.
"Tim and Sam, what are you doing?" she asked. "These are not your clothes. These are your grandparents' clothes. They are very special and old. You should not play with them. You could damage them or lose them. They are part of our family history. You should respect them and put them back in the trunk. And you should not unlock things that are not yours. You should ask permission first. Do you understand?"
Tim and Sam felt ashamed and sorry. They realized they had done something wrong. They took off the unusual clothes and put them back in the trunk. They locked it and gave the key to their mom. They apologized and hugged her.
"We're sorry, mom. We didn't know. We were just curious and wanted to have fun. We won't do it again. We love you and we love our grandparents. Can you tell us more about them and their clothes?" they asked.
Their mom smiled and forgave them. She was glad they learned their lesson. She told them stories about their grandparents and their clothes. She explained why they were unusual and what they meant. She showed them pictures and souvenirs. She said they could look at them again, but only with her. Tim and Sam listened and asked questions. They felt happy and proud to know more about their family. They understood that some things are not for playing, but for remembering and honoring. They thanked their mom and gave her a kiss. They went to have lunch and then played with their own toys and clothes. They still had fun, but they also had respect.

Once upon a time, there was a little puppy named Spot. Spot loved to play and chase his tail. One day, Spot went for a walk with his owner, Sarah. Sarah let Spot off his leash so he could run and play. Spot was having so much fun that he didn't notice when Sarah started to leave.
"Spot, come on! We have to go home now," Sarah called.
Spot didn't want to leave yet, but he knew he had to go with Sarah. He wagged his tail happily and followed her home.
When they got home, Sarah gave Spot a treat. Spot was so grateful that he licked Sarah's face. "Thank you for the treat!" Spot barked happily.
Sarah smiled and scratched Spot's tail. "You're welcome, Spot. I'm grateful to have you as my puppy."

One day, Billy 's mommy took him to the park. It was a big, sunny place full of fun and games.
As they walked around, they saw some birds flying in the sky, their wings making sharp movements in the air.
Billy then saw some children playing with a map. It looked very interesting. He wanted to play with them but they were too noisy.
"Billy, we need to be quieter," said mommy. "We don't have to shout to have fun. Being quiet can be more enjoyable".
Billy was upset that he couldn't play with the children and their map, but he understood that it was important to be polite and not too loud.
From that day, Billy and his mommy had lots of fun together playing games and exploring without being too noisy. They both learned that being respectful of others is often more fun than being too loud.

Once upon a time there was a little boy called Mark. He loved going for walks outside and collecting things. One day, Mark went for a walk and found a twig. He picked it up and thought it was very special. He held it tight and decided to take it home. 
On his way back, Mark saw a squirrel. It was very angry and scurried around looking for something. Mark forgot about his twig for a moment and wondered why the squirrel was so angry. Then he remembered his twig and quickly put it in his pocket. 
When Mark got home, he took the twig out of his pocket and marveled at how special it was. He smiled and was happy to have it. He kept it safely at home, never to forget how much he liked it!

Once upon a time, there was a big, noisy whale. He loved to swim and play in the sea. One day, he saw a little fish swimming nearby. The whale wanted to play with the fish, but he didn't know how to be gentle. So he threw the fish into the air and caught it again. The fish felt scared and didn't want to play with the whale anymore.
The whale felt sad when he saw that the fish was scared. He realized that he had been too rough and didn't want to hurt anyone again. From that day on, the whale learned to be gentle and kind to all the sea creatures. He made lots of new friends and they all loved to play together.
The moral of the story is that it's important to be kind and gentle to others, even if we are big and strong. We should always think about how our actions might affect others and try to be gentle with them.

Once upon a time, there was a farmer who had a big farm. He had many animals like cows, pigs, and chickens. The farmer worked hard every day to take care of them. 
One day, a little girl came to visit the farm. She saw how the farmer used his tools to take care of the animals. She thought the tools were very useful. 
The little girl admired the farmer for his hard work. She asked him if she could help. The farmer was happy to have some help and showed her how to feed the animals. The little girl was very happy to help and learned a lot about taking care of animals.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy called Max. Max wanted to go on an adventure. He put on his shoes and coat and went outside. He started to walk along the path that led out of the village. 
As he walked, he came across a farm. There were so many animals there! He could see horses, cows and sheep. The farm was so big and the animals were so cute!
Max wanted to go and pet one of the animals, but he was scared. He thought he might scare them away. So he just kept walking around the farm. Then, suddenly he noticed a sweet smell. It was coming from a little barn next to the farm.
Max went into the barn and saw a pile of hay. When he touched it, it was so soft! Then he heard something moving inside. It was a small, white, fluffy kitten!
Max kneeled down and said hello to the kitten. The kitten replied in a sweet voice. They talked for a bit and then the little kitten asked Max to come back again another day.
Max said goodbye to the kitten and left the little barn. As he started to walk home he thought to himself, "Farms can be so much fun!"

Once upon a time there was a loyal bear named Ben. Ben loved to sing and he sang all of the time. Every day he would help make meals for his family. He would help his mom stir the pot and he always remembered to stir it for a long time so the meal would be extra tasty.
Then one day his mom said he could pick any song he wanted to sing. Ben was so excited! He thought and thought about what song he would pick, but he couldn't decide. So, he just sang all his favorite songs. He sang so loudly that everyone in the house could hear him.
When he was finished singing, his mom said he did a wonderful job. She said she was so proud of how loyal he was to his family. Ben smiled and said that he had lots of love for his family. Then he went off to bed, dreaming of all the songs he wanted to sing.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. He loved playing with blocks and building tall towers. One day, he saw a big, popular building in the city. It was so tall and shiny, he wanted to own it someday.
Timmy worked hard and saved up his money. He bought a small piece of land and started building his own tower. It wasn't as big or shiny as the popular building, but he was proud of it.
Years went by and Timmy's tower became popular too. People came from all over to see it. One day, Timmy got a surprise phone call. The owner of the popular building wanted to buy Timmy's tower and put it next to theirs. Timmy was happy to sell and his dream of owning a piece of the popular building came true.

Once upon a time there was a boy called Jack. He was only 3 years old but he wanted to find something exciting.
One day, Jack looked around the house. He wanted to find something fun. Suddenly, Jack saw something shiny. He looked closer and it was a trumpet!
Jack picked it up and he put it to his lips. He blew as hard as he could and then, a big, loud noise came from the trumpet.
He loved it! He took it with him everywhere he went. He also loved to try new things, so he decided to make his trumpet even more exciting.
He added many different spices, such as chilli and pepper, to make his trumpet spicy. When he blew the trumpet, it made a very spicy sound and it was so delicious, he couldn't stop smiling.
Jack was so excited that he had found such a fun thing, and he enjoyed playing with his spicy trumpet every day!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to run and jump and play all day long. One day, while she was running, she fell down and hurt her knee. It was red and sore, and it made her cry.
Her mommy came running over and picked her up. She hugged her tight and made her feel warm and safe. Then, she took a band-aid and put it on Lily's knee. It fit perfectly and made her knee feel better. Lily smiled and hugged her mommy back. They went inside and had some warm milk and cookies. From that day on, Lily was more careful when she ran and played.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Lucy. She was 3 years old and loved playing with her friends.
One day, Lucy and her friends wanted to have a picnic at a nearby park. Everyone gathered what they needed, including a napkin for everyone to share. 
Lucy’s friend, Claire, took the napkin first. She said, “I’ll pass the napkin to you, Lucy.”
Lucy looked at the napkin. It was clear and she could see the other side. She said, “Thank you, Claire! Now I can have a bite of my sandwich.” 
Claire smiled and said, “You’re welcome, Lucy. Why don’t we take a nap after the picnic?” 
Lucy nodded eagerly and said, “Yes, please! I’m so tired already.”
And that was the end of their picnic. They all had a nice nap in the cool park and went home happy.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her friends. One sunny day, Lily and her friends decided to have a picnic in the park. They brought sandwiches, fruit, and cookies.
As they were eating, Lily's friend Alex noticed that his water bottle was empty. "I need more water," he said. "Can we go to the water line?" 
Lily knew where the water line was. She had seen it before. "Sure," she said. "Let's go." 
When they got to the water line, they saw a big scale. "What's that?" Lily asked. 
"It's a scale," Alex said. "You can weigh things on it." 
Lily thought that was cool. She wanted to weigh something too. "Can we weigh my cookie?" she asked. 
They put the cookie on the scale and saw that it weighed one ounce. "Wow!" Lily said. "That's not very heavy." 
As they walked back to their picnic spot, they noticed that the sun was getting hot. "It's a hot day," Lily said. "But at least we have water and cookies!"

Once upon a time there was an old man who wanted to get to the other side of the river. Unfortunately, the river was too wide for him to cross and he had no boat. He was stuck. As he stood there, looking sadly at the river, he spotted a stubborn swan swimming towards him. The old man was surprised and sad, but he decided to ask the swan for help. 
He shouted to the swan, “Can you help me to cross the river?”
The swan then stopped swimming and replied, “I can help, but you will have to split up my feathers to make a raft.”
The old man agreed and started picking up feathers and piling them up. After a while, he had enough feathers to make a raft. The old man then climbed onto the raft and started paddling across the river. He reached the other side and thanked the swan, who swam away. 
The old man was happy and grateful to the stubborn swan for helping him. He went on his way, never forgetting what the swan had done for him.

Once upon a time there was a little boy named Sam. He was very fair, with bright blue eyes and a big smile. One day, he saw a lump of coal in the backyard. He asked his mom, "What is this?"
"It's coal," answered his mom.
Sam was very curious. He asked her, "What is this coal for?"
"Well," said his mom, "coal can be used to make lots of things, like energy and heat. It belongs to all of us, so we should use it fairly."
Sam nodded thoughtfully. He understood that coal belonged to the whole world, and it was his responsibility to share it fairly. He smiled and said, "Ok, I will!" 
From then on, Sam made sure to use coal fairly and responsibly.

Once upon a time, there was a happy bird named Bluey. Bluey liked to fly high up in the sky and feel the warm sun on his feathers. He would flap his wings and soar through the clouds, feeling very free.
One day, Bluey saw a group of lively birds playing in a nearby tree. They were singing and chirping and having a lot of fun. Bluey wanted to join in, so he flew down to the tree and said hello.
The lively birds welcomed Bluey and they all played together. They flew around the tree and sang songs in the sun. Bluey felt very happy to have new friends and he knew that he would soar with them again soon.

Bella loved to bounce on her big red ball. She bounced up and down, left and right, all over the yard. She liked to pretend that she was a rocket, flying to the moon and the stars.
One day, she saw a new boy in the house next door. He had a small blue rocket in his hand. He looked troubled. He did not smile or wave at Bella.
"Hi, I'm Bella," she said, bouncing over to him. "What's your name?"
"Tommy," he said, looking at his rocket. "I just moved here with my mom and dad."
"Do you like rockets?" Bella asked. "I do. I have a big red ball that I bounce like a rocket."
Tommy nodded. "I like rockets too. But mine is broken. It won't fly. It just falls down."
Bella felt sorry for Tommy. She wanted to help him. She had an idea.
"Maybe we can fix your rocket," she said. "Or we can make a new one. We can use some cardboard and tape and paint. And we can bounce on my ball together. It will be fun."
Tommy looked at Bella. He saw her big smile and her bright eyes. He felt a little better. He liked her idea.
"Okay," he said. "Let's try it. Maybe we can be friends."
Bella nodded. She took his hand and led him to her yard. She bounced on her ball and he followed her. They laughed and talked and played. They made a new rocket and bounced it to the sky. They became friends. They were happy.

Once upon a time, there was an adventurous little girl called Sarah. She loved to explore everywhere and learn new things. Today, Sarah wanted to go to the shop. She put on her shoes and grabbed her bag. 
Sarah said goodbye to her mommy and walked out the door. She felt so brave and excited - it was her first ever time walking alone. She skipped and hopped all the way to the shop. 
Once Sarah got to the shop, she started to look around. There were so many things to see and choose from! She saw the sweet treats and colourful toys, and even picked out a new, sparkly headband for herself. 
When it was time to go home, Sarah said goodbye to the shop keeper, who had helped her find some goodies for her friends at home. Holding onto her shopping bag, Sarah took a deep breath and started her walk home. Even when it got a bit dark, she wasn't scared - she knew she would make it home safe. 
When Sarah finally arrived home, she couldn"t stop talking about her wonderful, adventurous day. She was so proud of herself for taking the journey all by herself and couldn't wait to do it all over again!

Once upon a time there were two friends named Bobby and Jimmy. Bobby was a very naughty boy and he liked to buy things. One day, Jimmy told Bobby that he shouldn't buy so many things because he was being naughty. 
Bobby didn't want to listen to Jimmy and he kept buying whatever he wanted. This made Jimmy really mad, so he decided to take away all of Bobby's money.
Bobby cried and said he was sorry to Jimmy, and promised to not buy any more things without his friend's permission. Jimmy was happy to hear this and they hugged and made up.
From then on, Bobby and Jimmy would always check with each other before buying anything. They were friends again, and they lived happily ever after!

Once upon a time, there was a big, hairy rabbit named Bongo. Bongo loved to eat radishes from the garden. One day, Bongo saw a little bird sitting on a branch. Bongo wanted to play with the bird, but he accidentally slapped the bird with his big, hairy paw. 
The little bird was very sad and flew away. Bongo felt bad and wanted to say sorry, but the bird was already gone. Bongo went back to eating his radishes, but he didn't feel happy anymore. 
Later that day, a big, scary fox came into the garden. Bongo tried to run away, but the fox caught him and ate him for dinner. The end.

Once upon a time, there were two friends, a banana and an apple. They were very different. The banana was yellow and soft, and the apple was red and crunchy.
The two friends wanted to unite and be different at the same time. So they decided to put on colorful clothes. The banana put on a green shirt and a blue hat and the apple put on a yellow shirt and a purple hat.
When they both had on their colorful clothes, they looked very nice together. Everyone in the park noticed and smiled.
The banana and the apple decided to take a walk and found more colorful friends. They all united together and made the park full of color!
The banana and apple went back to the park every day and made more colorful friends. They all blessed the park with their joy and united to make it even more beautiful.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toys. He had a favorite old teddy bear that he always carried with him. One day, Timmy's friend Jimmy came over to play. Jimmy saw the old teddy bear and said, "That toy is not cool. I don't like it."
Timmy felt sad and said, "I disagree. My teddy bear is very special to me. It has a lot of value because it was a gift from my grandma."
Jimmy thought about it and said, "You're right. I'm sorry for saying that. Maybe I can play with your teddy bear too."
Timmy smiled and said, "That's okay. We can share it." They played together happily with the old teddy bear and had a lot of fun. From then on, Jimmy understood the value of old toys and never disagreed with Timmy again.

Once there were two best friends - John and Sarah. They were really good buddies and loved playing together.
One day, the two friends were in their toy room and saw something special at the back - an exciting exit! They knew that it would be fun to explore and so John decided to pull it open.
As soon as he opened the door, they saw that they were in a new and strange place they had not seen before. They were a bit troubled because they weren't quite sure what to do.
As they looked around, they spotted something amazing - a magic carpet! Sarah suggested they get on and pull the rope to fly away. They each grabbed ahold of the rope and pulled. Then, up into the sky they flew! 
John and Sarah were so happy to explore these new lands with their magic carpet and they were never troubled again!

Once upon a time, there was a mom and her three-year-old son. They planned a fun day out together. They drove in the car and parked near a park. 
The two were excited to go play in the park but then it started to rain. The mom saw how worried her son was and said, "Don't worry, we can still have a good time! Let's just find something else to do." 
Her son got a big smile on his face and said, "Let's go home and bake cookies!" 
So, they drove back home with a big smile and went to the kitchen to make delicious cookies. The mom was happy knowing that she was able to turn her son's worry into something fun. 
They made the best cookies ever and enjoyed the day together.

Lily and Ben were twins who liked to play outside. One day, they saw a big cart with many toys on it. The cart was red and shiny, and it had wheels and a handle. Lily and Ben wanted to play with the toys, so they ran to the cart.
"Look, Ben, there is a doll and a truck and a ball and a book!" Lily said. She gazed at the toys with wide eyes. She reached for the doll, but Ben grabbed it first.
"No, Lily, this is mine!" Ben said. He held the doll close to his chest. He gazed at the truck and wanted it too. He tried to take it from the cart, but Lily stopped him.
"No, Ben, this is mine!" Lily said. She pulled the truck from his hand. She gazed at the ball and wanted it too. She tried to take it from the cart, but Ben stopped her.
They both wanted all the toys, and they started to fight. They pulled and pushed and shouted. They were very upset.
"Hey, hey, stop that!" a voice said. It was the man who owned the cart. He came out of his house and saw the twins fighting over his toys. He was not happy. He gazed at them with a frown.
"These are not your toys, these are mine!" the man said. "I was going to sell them at the market, but you ruined them. Look, the doll is torn and the truck is broken and the ball is dirty and the book is wet. You are very naughty!"
Lily and Ben felt sorry. They did not mean to ruin the toys. They gazed at the man with sad eyes.
"We are sorry, mister," they said. "We just wanted to play. Can we help you fix the toys?"
The man sighed. He gazed at the twins with a soft smile.
"Well, you are sorry, and that is good," he said. "But you should not take things that are not yours. You should ask first. And you should share with each other. Do you understand?"
Lily and Ben nodded. They understood. They helped the man fix the toys. They also learned to share with each other. They gazed at the toys with happy eyes. They thanked the man and went home. They were not upset anymore. They were friends.

Once upon a time, a little girl called Anna loved the beach. She would dream of the amazing sand and the calming blue sea. 
One day, Anna asked her mum if they could go to the beach and she said yes. So off they went to the beach, with bags full of toys and snacks. 
Anna was so excited when she saw the beach and all the amazing shells. She started spending her day building sandcastles and playing with her toys. 
Suddenly, it started to rain. Anna was worried and so was her mum. They gathered all the toys, grabbed their bags and ran quickly to the car. 
But as they got close, Anna saw a most amazing sight. The rain had made all of the sand sparkle and shimmer. As a special treat, her mum said they could stay and watch. 
So Anna stayed, bouncing up and down in amazement. After a while, the rain stopped and the wonderful beach shone. Anna had a most amazing day.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Suzy and she had a mommy and daddy. Today, Suzy was feeling very curious. She wanted to peek inside the kitchen and find out what kind of yummy treats mommy was baking.
So, Suzy sneakily tippy-toed over to the kitchen door and peeked around the corner. She saw some yummy cookies on the counter. Suddenly, her mommy heard Suzy and said, "Suzy, why are you peeking around the corner?"
Suzy felt a little bit guilty, so she looked down and said, "I just wanted to see what kind of yummy treats you were making for me." Mommy smiled and said, "Come here and sit on my shoulder so you can watch. But always remember not to peek at things that are not for you to look at."
Suzy was very happy and she'll always remember the lessons she learned that day. Peeking into other people's business can lead to unwanted trouble.

Once upon a time, there was a big, fierce lion. He lived in a jungle with many other animals. One day, the lion got hurt while playing with his friends. His paw hurt so much that he couldn't walk anymore. The other animals didn't know what to do, so they went to ask the wise owl for help.
The owl said that they needed a mechanic to fix the lion's paw. The animals didn't know what a mechanic was, so the owl explained that it's someone who fixes things. The animals searched the jungle and finally found a kind monkey who was a mechanic. The monkey was happy to help and asked for permission to fix the lion's paw.
The lion was scared at first, but the monkey was gentle and kind. He fixed the lion's paw and soon the lion could walk again. The other animals were so happy and grateful to the monkey. They realized that sometimes we need help from others and it's okay to ask for permission to get the help we need.

Once upon a time there was a wild cat. He was wandering through the woods looking for a place he could call home. As he was looking, he passed by a clearing. There, on the floor was a strange box. The wild cat decided to take a closer look. The cat hopped in and found it was the perfect place for him to belong.
The wild cat curled up inside and fell asleep. After a while, a little girl spotted the cat in the box. She waved her hands and danced around, she was so excited. She wanted to take the cat, she knew he belonged with her. The cat meowed and said yes, so she carefully took him home.
Once home, the little girl chose for the cat a special place. It was a soft, fluffy rug on the floor. She knew it would be the perfect place for the cat to nap and play. The cat moved in right away and was so happy, he even jumped and purred to show he was happy he belonged. 
From that day on, the wild cat felt like he belonged with the little girl and her family. He found his true home and he was very happy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play the flute. He played it every day and he was very good at it. But one day, Timmy's flute broke. It was very sad for Timmy because he loved his flute so much.
Timmy's mom saw how sad he was and decided to replace his flute. She went to the store and bought him a brand new flute. Timmy was so happy! He played his new flute and it sounded even better than his old one.
At first, it was difficult for Timmy to play his new flute. But he practiced every day and soon he was playing just as well as before. Timmy was so happy with his new flute and he played it every day for the rest of his life. The end.

One day, a little pigeon was flying in the sky. He was having fun and going up and down. He saw a big tree and wanted to land on a branch.
The pigeon landed on the branch and saw a squirrel. The squirrel said, "What do you do here?" The pigeon said, "I am just flying and having fun." The squirrel said, "Be careful, do not hit the tree."
But the pigeon did not listen. He was not careful and hit the tree. The pigeon felt sorry and said, "I am sorry, squirrel. I should have listened to you." The squirrel said, "It is okay, pigeon. Just be more careful next time."
The pigeon learned to be careful when flying near trees. He said thank you to the squirrel and flew away. From that day on, the pigeon always remembered to be careful and listen to his friends.

Tom and Sam are two squirrels who live in a big park. They like to play and look for nuts to eat. One day, they see a large nut on a branch. It is bigger than any nut they have ever seen.
"Wow, look at that nut!" Tom says. "It is so large and shiny. I want to eat it."
"Me too," Sam says. "But how can we get it? It is too high and far."
They stare at the nut and think of a way to reach it. They see a long vine hanging from another tree. They have an idea.
"Let's swing on the vine and grab the nut," Tom says.
"OK, let's try," Sam says.
They run to the vine and take turns to swing on it. They stretch their paws and try to catch the nut. But the nut is too large and heavy. It does not move.
"Ouch, this nut is hard," Tom says.
"It hurts my paw," Sam says.
They swing and swing, but they cannot get the nut. They are tired and hungry.
"Let's give up," Tom says. "This nut is not worth it. There are many other nuts in the park."
"OK, let's go," Sam says. "Maybe we can find a smaller and softer nut."
They leave the vine and the large nut. They do not know that the nut is not a real nut. It is a plastic toy that a child left on the branch. They run and play and look for other nuts. They are happy and forget about the large nut.

Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit named Bun. Bun loved to hop around in the fields and play with his friends. One day, Bun saw a wise old owl sitting on a tree branch. 
"Hello, Mr. Owl!" said Bun. "What are you doing up there?"
"I'm just watching the world go by," replied Mr. Owl. "What are you up to, little one?"
"I'm playing with my friends," said Bun. "We're trying to make a mark in the ground with our hopping!"
"That sounds like fun," said Mr. Owl. "But remember, it's not about how high you hop or how big your mark is. It's about having fun with your friends."
Bun thought about what Mr. Owl said and decided to go back to playing with his friends without worrying about their marks. They all hopped around happily, enjoying each other's company. And from that day on, Bun knew that being wise meant having fun with friends, not just making big marks.

Once upon a time, there was a strong bus. The bus was travelling through the forest when it suddenly got a flat tire. The driver was so sad and the other passengers were getting worried. Suddenly a little boy stepped out of the forest. He was very kind and smiled at everyone. He asked the driver of the bus if he could help. With the little boy's help, the bus soon had a new tire and was ready to go. The driver was so happy, he wanted to thank the little boy. He wanted to give him something special. But the little boy shook his head. He didn't want anything; he was happy just to help. "All I want," he said, "is for you to forgive everyone who ever made a mistake." The driver looked at the little boy and smiled. He thought that was a very kind thing to say. The driver of the bus thanked the little boy again, and the bus drove off into the sunset.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys all day long. One day, she saw her little brother crying because he didn't have a cushion to sit on. She felt sad for him and decided to help.
Lily went to her room and found a cushion. She brought it to her brother and he was very happy. He thanked her and gave her a big hug. Lily felt proud of herself for being able to supply her brother with what he needed.
Later that day, Lily's mom asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't want to do it because she was tired. But then she remembered how happy she made her brother by supplying him with a cushion. She realized that doing things for others can make them happy.
From that day on, Lily made sure to help her family whenever she could. She learned that being kind and helpful is never disgusting, but always the right thing to do.

Once upon a time, there was a little duck named Ducky. Ducky lived in a pond with her friends, the fishies. One day, it rained a lot and the pond started to flood. Ducky got very scared and asked her fishy friends what to do.
One fishy said, "We need to yield to the flood and swim to higher ground!"
Ducky was very sleepy and didn't want to swim, but she knew she had to be brave. So, she followed her fishy friends and they swam to a nearby hill. 
But when they got there, they saw that the hill was already crowded with other animals who had also run away from the flood. They were all arguing about who should be allowed to stay. 
Ducky said, "Let's not fight. We can share the hill and all sleep here tonight."
Everyone agreed and they all had a peaceful night's sleep. The next day, the flood had gone down and they all went back to their homes in the pond, happy to be safe and sound. The end.

Once upon a time there was a white puppy. His fur was so soft and he had a healthy, shiny coat. Every morning his owner would take him outside in the garden and they would play together. They would have lots of fun rolling and hopping around the garden. 
The sun was always so warm and the puppy loved it. He would close his eyes and just rub his head in the grass. The feeling was so nice it made him doze off. Sunbathing made him feel so happy and content. When he was done he was always full of energy and ready to play some more. 
The puppy and his owner were best friends. Every day the puppy would wait for his Owner to come home so that they could go out and play together. 
The white puppy was the happiest and healthiest puppy around. And the feeling of the sun and the grass against his fur always made him feel like everything was perfect in the world.

One day there was a humble triangle. It was small but had plenty of uses.
"My triangle is the best!" said a 3-year-old.
The triangle kept its calm and kept on being humble. It said nothing, because it knew it could be used in different ways.
The 3-year-old then picked up the triangle and used it to make a paper airplane. She was so delighted and said, "Oh wow! Look at my triangle, it made a great paper airplane!" 
The triangle was still content and humble. It was happy that it could be used to make something so cool. It was the perfect shape for it. 
The 3-year-old thanked the triangle for being so useful. The triangle smiled knowing it had made someone so happy.

One day, a little girl named Lucy was walking through the park. She was very alert and looking around for any fun things to do. Suddenly, she saw a big tree with lots of sharp leaves. She was excited, so she started to jump around and touch the leaves. She had to be careful not to get any cuts!
After a while, Lucy decided to take a break and sat down on a park bench. Suddenly she heard a loud noise, like a beeping sound. Then she saw something she had never seen before—a big, green test! It wasn't moving, but Lucy could tell it was very important. 
She walked over to it and tried to touch it, but it was too high up. She was about to walk away when something caught her eye—a button! She was so alert that she noticed it right away. She reached up and pressed it.
Suddenly, the test changed colors and made a loud noise. Lucy was so excited that she started to jump around again. She didn't know what had happened, but she was glad it worked! Then she took one more sharp look around and then ran off to find new adventures.

One day, John wanted to go and see some dolphins. He was very enthusiastic, so he got dressed quickly and ran to the beach. He saw a family of dolphins that were so friendly. They were playing in the water, swimming around and jumping up and down. 
John waved to them from the beach and they waved their fins back. He clapped his hands and the dolphins swam around him. He was so young, but so enthusiastic about the dolphins. 
Then, it was time for the dolphins to go home. They said goodbye to John and he waved and said goodbye too. John was sad, but he stayed and watched them until they were out of sight. 
John was so happy to see the dolphins and he was already planning his next trip to the beach. He couldn't wait to see them again.

Once upon a time there was a chubby mouse. He wanted to make a special sauce for his friends. He went all around the house looking for things to put into the sauce. He found some carrots, a bit of butter and some pepper. But he still needed something extra.
He decided to go outside to find what he was looking for. After a while he saw a big juicy tomato. That was it! He quickly grabbed it and ran back home.
He began to cut up everything and mix it together to make his special sauce. When he was finished he tasted it and it was delicious! He was so happy he had completed his sauce.
He took the sauce to his friends and they all loved it. They had lots of fun eating it together.
