Tom was a cat who liked to play outside. He ran, jumped and chased birds and mice. He did not like to take baths or brush his fur. He thought he looked fine with his dirty, tangled coat.
One day, it was very cold and windy. Tom wanted to find a warm place to sleep. He saw a big house with a nice garden. He sneaked in through a hole in the fence. He saw a dog house with a soft blanket inside. He thought it was perfect for him.
He crawled into the dog house and curled up on the blanket. He felt cozy and happy. He did not know that the dog house belonged to Rex, a big, friendly dog who lived in the house.
Soon, Rex came back from his walk with his owner. He smelled a strange scent in his dog house. He barked and ran to see who was there. He saw Tom, the dirty cat, sleeping on his blanket. He was angry and scared.
"Who are you? Get out of my house!" Rex growled.
Tom woke up and saw Rex. He was terrified. He hissed and scratched Rex's nose. He tried to run away, but Rex blocked his way.
"Leave me alone! I just wanted to be warm!" Tom cried.
Rex and Tom fought and made a lot of noise. Their owner heard them and came to see what was wrong. He saw Rex and Tom, both hurt and scared. He picked up Tom and took him inside. He cleaned his wounds and gave him some food and water. He also gave him a bath and brushed his fur. He made him look clean and shiny.
He also checked on Rex and gave him a treat and a hug. He told him he was a good boy for protecting his house. He also told him he was sorry for the cat who was lost and cold.
He put Tom in a cage and called the animal shelter. He hoped they would find a good home for him. He felt sorry for him, but he knew he could not keep him. He already had Rex, who was his best friend.
Tom felt warm and full, but also sad and lonely. He wished he had a friend like Rex. He wished he had taken better care of himself. He realized he had been selfish and rude. He shivered in his cage and licked his paw. He hoped someone would love him and teach him how to be a good cat. He learned a hard lesson that day. He learned that being dirty and mean was not fun or smart. He learned that being clean and kind was better for him and others.

Once upon a time, there was a bald man and he was very patient. One day, he decided to settle in a new town. He looked at all of the houses and stores and found one he liked. He took his time and unpacked his things carefully.
Once he was done, he admired his new home. He liked all of the new things he saw and could not wait to start his day. He quickly set out to explore the new town. He visited all of the shops and talked to the people there.
All of the people were so friendly and welcoming. He felt like he was a part of the town already. Everyone made him feel so comfortable and at home. He was so happy in his new place and knew he could settle there forever.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and go on adventures. One day, Lily went to the park with her mommy. They were having fun on the swings when Lily saw a scary bug.
"Mommy, look at that scary bug!" Lily said.
"It's okay, Lily. Bugs are our friends. They help us by eating other bugs," her mommy said.
Lily was still scared. "But what if it bites me and I suffer?"
"Don't worry, Lily. This bug is harmless. Let's go play on the slide instead," her mommy said.
Lily forgot about the scary bug and went to play on the slide. She had so much fun with her mommy and was happy that she didn't have to suffer from the scary bug's bite.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went to the park with her mom and saw a new friend. Her mom said, "Let's introduce ourselves!" Lily said, "Hi, my name is Lily. What's your name?" The new friend said, "My name is Sarah. Nice to meet you!" 
Lily and Sarah played together on the swings. They went up and down, up and down. Then, they saw a big, heavy truck drive by. It made a loud noise and shook the ground. Lily and Sarah waved to the truck as it drove away. 
After playing for a while, it was time for Lily to go home. She said goodbye to Sarah and waved goodbye. Lily was happy to have a new friend and couldn't wait to play with her again.

Once upon a time, there was a poor girl. She was very sad. Everywhere she looked she saw people happy, but she was not.
She was so sad that she decided to take a drink from a pond. She did not know that the pond was poisoned. After she drank from the pond, she became sick.
The poor girl was very afraid, but then a kind lady came along. She brought her food and showed her how to relax. She taught her special breathing and stretching exercises.
The girl followed the kind lady's instructions and soon she felt better. She had the energy to get up and she was no longer sad. 
From then on, the poor girl was happy and she learned how to relax so she could stay healthy and safe.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the sun. One day, she went for a walk in the woods with her mommy and daddy. They found a little creek that was very pretty. 
Lily's mommy said, "Let's make a picnic by the creek." Daddy made sandwiches and mommy made some yummy fruit salad. Lily helped by picking flowers to put on the blanket. 
After they ate, Lily dipped her toes in the creek. She said, "The water is so tasty!" Mommy and daddy laughed and said, "No, silly, water is not tasty. But we're glad you like it!" They all had a fun day by the creek and went home happy.

Once upon a time there was a nice mule. He loved to create things. Every day he would make something new with his hooves. He created castles, cars and funny hats.
One day, he decided to show his creations to the world. He took all of his creations and went on a nice walk. Everywhere he went, people were amazed at his magical creations.
After a while, the mule's creations became famous. Soon everyone wanted to have one of his creations. The mule kept creating more things, so everyone had something special.
The mule was so happy that he had created something that made everyone happy. He was so proud of his creations. From that day on, he kept creating even more magical things.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Clara. Every day, Clara loved to play in her garden with her switch. Her switch was so smooth and colourful!
One day, Clara saw her neighbour in their garden and asked, “Can I borrow your switch?”.
The neighbour smiled and said, “Of course! Here you go”. Clara was so excited and ran back to her garden to start playing with the new switch.
Clara and her neighbour had lots of fun playing together with their switches every day. They were so happy! 
The end.

Once there was a wise owl. He lived in a tall tree. One day he was feeling grumpy and he wanted to do something fun. So he decided to build a stack. But it didn't turn out the way he planned. 
The stack just kept getting higher and higher. Soon it was the highest stack ever made! The wise owl was so excited that he started to yell out loud. Everyone in the forest heard him and came to see the tall stack. 
The animals all cheered and clapped for the wise owl. They couldn't believe how big the stack was. They all thanked the wise owl for making such a fun stack. 
From then on, the wise owl would build a stack whenever he felt grumpy. It always cheered him up and made him happy. He became the most famous owl in the forest!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lucy. She was three years old and had lots of friends. Every day, she would invite them to her house to play. One day, Lucy got a special gift. It was a cactus! She was so happy and jumped with joy. She quickly invited her friends over to show them her new plant.
When her friends arrived, they could not believe their eyes. They had never seen such a cactus before! The cactus had so many spines and looked very different. It was quite helpless without someone to care for it.
Lucy's friends were amazed. They were excited to help her care for her new cactus. They took turns giving it water and making sure it had enough sunlight. After a few weeks, the cactus started to bloom and everyone was so proud of it! 
Lucy and her friends were really happy that they could help out. It was a great reminder of the power of working together.

One day, a little boy named Tim went for a walk. It was a mild day, with the sun shining and birds singing. Tim loved to explore and examine everything he saw.
As Tim walked, he found a small key on the ground. He picked it up and looked at it closely. The key was shiny and pretty. Tim thought it must open something special.
Tim looked around and saw a little box under a tree. He tried the key and it opened the box! Inside, he found a toy car. Tim was so happy to have a new toy. He played with the car all day and took the key home to keep it safe.

Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess. She was very careful, and she always tried her best to make sure that nothing bad happened to her. One day, the princess was taking a walk in the forest when she stumbled across a lake. 
The princess saw a ball floating in the lake and she said to herself, "I think I'll try and throw the ball out of the lake!" She carefully reached out and tried to throw the ball, but she wasn't strong enough to do it. 
Suddenly, a brave knight appeared and said, "Don't worry! I'll throw the ball out of the lake for you!" The knight threw the ball so far that it landed right in the princess' hands. She smiled and said, "Thank you, brave knight!" The knight smiled and bowed, and then he left to go and continue his mission. 
The princess was so grateful, and she was reminded to be careful when she went exploring again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved waking up early to see the sunrise. One day, she woke up and saw that the sky was yellow. She was very happy because she knew that meant the sunrise would be extra pretty.
Lily went outside to watch the sunrise with her mom. "Look, Mommy! The sunrise is so pretty today!" Lily said. "Yes, it is," her mom replied. "The yellow sky provides a beautiful background for the sunrise."
Lily and her mom sat and watched the sunrise together. They talked about how the sun makes everything warm and bright. Lily was so happy to spend the morning with her mom and see the beautiful yellow sunrise.

Once there was a tall girl called Sally. She liked sports very much. Every day, she played sports until the sun went down. One day, Sally wanted to play her favorite sport, but it was raining. She was sad because the rain prevented her from playing her sport.
Then, Sally had a great idea. She took some newspapers and built a tall house using them. Under the tall house, she played her sport and it was dry.
She was so happy that the tall house had prevented the rain from stopping her from playing her sport. Every time it rained, Sally built her tall house and played her sport in the dry.
For many days and many months, Sally was able to play her sport without the rain stopping her. She was glad that the tall house had prevented the rain from ruining her sport games!

One day, a little girl called Lucy was walking through the woods with her mum. As they walked, they came across a lovely pond with a trap set up next to it. "Mummy, what's that?" Lucy asked.
"It's a trap, to catch fish," her mum replied.
Just then Lucy noticed a frog sitting by the trap. "Oh look mummy, a frog!" she said.
The frog looked up at Lucy. "Will you lend me a hand?" it asked.
Lucy was very excited. She bent down, and very carefully and gently, she untied the trap. "There you go," she said, "you can go now". The frog thanked her, croaked happily and hopped away.
Lucy and her mum continued their walk and watched the frog as it hopped into the sunshine. "That was so lovely of you," said her mum.
Lucy smiled. She knew she had done something very special - she had lent a helping hand to a frog in need.

Once upon a time there was a shy king who ruled over a kingdom. In his kingdom he had recorders who wrote down everything the king said and did. One day the king was feeling very shy and he decided to hide. He tried to make sure no one could find him. Suddenly one of the recorders noticed the king had gone missing and he declared an alert. The entire kingdom searched everywhere but they could not find the king. Everyone was getting worried. After days of searching the kingdom finally found the king! He had been hiding in the nearby forest. The recorders were overjoyed and they quickly got to work and recorded all the events of the king's disappearance. The kingdom was relieved and the shy king vowed to never hide again.

Once there was a little girl named Amy. Every morning her mother used to give her a special case to take with her to school. In it was a healthy snack, an extra dress and a special toy.
One day, when Amy was getting ready for school, her mother said: "Amy, please don't forget to take your case with you."
Amy replied: "I know mummy, I always take it."
At school, the teacher asked the children to share their snacks with the other children. When it was Amy's turn, she looked into the case and saw that it was almost empty. She had eaten all the snacks without thinking about sharing them.
Amy was ashamed of her behaviour, so she politely said to the teacher: "I'm sorry, I didn't bring a snack for the other children."
The teacher hugged Amy and said: "It's ok, but from now on, you should always share with others, it's not regular to keep everything for yourself." 
Amy was happy that her teacher taught her such an important lesson: always share with others!

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys, but he also loved to go on adventures. One day, Timmy went to the store with his mom. He saw a toy he really wanted, but he didn't know the price.
"Mommy, how much does this toy use?" Timmy asked.
"It costs ten dollars," his mom replied.
Timmy didn't have ten dollars, but he really wanted the toy. "Can we go on an adventurous treasure hunt to find the money?" he asked his mom.
His mom smiled. "Sure, let's go on an adventure to find the money for the toy."
So, Timmy and his mom went on a treasure hunt. They searched high and low until they found a shiny coin on the ground. It was worth ten dollars! Timmy was so happy that he could finally buy the toy he wanted.
"Thank you, Mommy, for going on an adventurous treasure hunt with me," Timmy said.
"You're welcome, Timmy. I'm glad we found the money for your toy," his mom replied with a smile.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily had a teddy bear that she loved very much. One day, Lily lost her teddy bear and she was very sad. She looked everywhere for her teddy bear, but she couldn't find it. Lily started to feel anxious and worried that she would never find her teddy bear.
Lily's mommy saw that Lily was suffering because she lost her teddy bear. She tried to help Lily find her teddy bear, but they still couldn't find it. Then, Lily's daddy had an idea. He remembered that they went to the park yesterday and maybe the teddy bear was left there. They went to the park and found the teddy bear! Lily was so happy and she hugged her teddy bear tightly. She was no longer anxious and her smile came back. From that day on, Lily never let go of her teddy bear again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved ponies and always wanted one. One day, her parents surprised her with a beautiful pony named Daisy. Lily was so happy and welcomed Daisy with open arms.
But one day, Lily woke up to a gloomy day. She didn't feel happy and didn't want to play with Daisy. Daisy was sad and didn't understand why Lily didn't want to play. Lily's mom noticed how sad Daisy was and asked Lily what was wrong. Lily told her mom that she was feeling sad and didn't want to play.
Her mom explained to Lily that sometimes we have bad days, but it's important to still be kind and welcoming to others. Lily realized that she had been ignoring Daisy and not being kind. She went outside and welcomed Daisy back with open arms. From that day on, Lily learned that even on gloomy days, it's important to be kind and welcoming to others.

One day, a little bird named Tim was feeling very dull. He lived in a small tree and did not have many friends. Tim wanted to live in luxury like the other birds he saw in the big trees. He thought that if he could sing like them, he would be happy and make new friends.
Tim went to his friend Sue, the squirrel. He said, "Sue, I want to sing like the birds in the big trees. Can you help me?" Sue thought for a moment and said, "Yes, Tim. Let's go to the big tree and listen to them sing. Then you can try to sing like them."
Tim and Sue went to the big tree and listened to the birds sing. They tried to copy their songs, but it was hard. Tim did not give up. He practiced every day with Sue. Soon, Tim could sing just like the birds in the big tree. He was so happy!
One day, while Tim was singing, the birds from the big tree came to visit him. They said, "Tim, you sing so well! We want to be your friends and live with you in your tree." Tim's tree became a luxury tree filled with friends who loved to sing.
From that day on, Tim was never dull again. He had many friends, and they all sang together in their luxury tree. Tim learned that with practice and help from friends, anything is possible.

Once upon a time, there was a bird who wanted to fly to a faraway place. He asked his friend, an elephant, for help. The elephant said, "You must get a passport first." The bird was sad, for he did not have a passport.
Suddenly, an idea popped into the bird's head. He asked the elephant for their passport instead. The elephant thought this was a foolish idea, and told the bird, "no way!" But still the bird asked, "Please, just lend it to me for a day?" 
The kind-hearted elephant wouldn't give in. The bird tried to change the elephant's mind, but still, the elephant said "no". Then, the bird felt a sudden drop in his heart.
But suddenly, the elephant agreed. The elephant said, "Just this once", and gave the bird the passport. The bird was so excited. With the passport in hand, he could finally fly to a faraway place. 
He thanked his friend, gave him a big hug and took off. As the bird flew away, all he could think was, "I'm going to see the world!"

Once upon a time, there was a little boy who liked to play outside. He loved to run and jump and play with his friends. One day, he noticed a youth sitting all alone on a bench. The youth looked sad and lonely.
The little boy went over to talk to the youth. He asked him why he was sad. The youth said he had lost his way and didn't know how to get home. The little boy wanted to help, so he offered to walk the youth home.
As they walked, the sun began to set and the light started to fade. They were getting farther away from the little boy's house and he started to feel scared. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise and a car came speeding towards them. The little boy tried to push the youth out of the way, but it was too late. The car hit them both and they were hurt very badly.
The little boy's family was very sad when they heard the news. They knew he had been trying to help the youth and they were proud of him. But they were also very sad that he had been hurt. The little boy didn't make it, but his family knew he had died trying to do something good.

Once upon a time there was a little girl who was very sad. She had lost her knife. She looked for it everywhere, but couldn't find it. She started to cry.
Suddenly, a kind and compassionate boy saw her. He asked her why she was so upset. The girl told him about her lost knife. The kind boy was determined to help her find it and told her to come with him.
He looked all around the ground, and after a few minutes he spotted the knife in some tall grass. He picked it up with a smile and handed it to the little girl.
The girl was so happy that she had found her knife. And she was so thankful to the kind boy. She hugged the boy and said, "Thanks for helping me find it."
The kind boy smiled and said, "You're welcome." He was glad he had helped her find her lost knife.

Joe was playing in the park one day. He jumped and ran around and noticed a large bubble floating in the air nearby. Joe ran over to the bubble and touched it with his finger. His finger got cold, so he pulled it away. He wondered what could make his finger cold like that.
Joe asked his mom, "What was that cold thing?" His mom smiled. "That was a bubble. We can make more if you want."
Joe was excited. He watched as his mom blew a bubble and floated it into the air. Joe couldn't believe how the bubble moved. He chased the bubble around and laughed loudly. 
Suddenly, Joe noticed the sky had turned grey. His mom said, "I think it's going to rain. We'd better go home now." 
Joe wasn't ready to go home. He still wanted to play with the bubble. But his mom was right, it was starting to rain. Joe reluctantly said goodbye to the bubble and went home with his mom. 
At home, Joe and his mom curled up under a warm blanket and watched the rain outside of the window. Joe saw his bubble again in the rain. It made him smile, because it was still there in the rain, cold and beautiful.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl called Laure who had a very big brain. Laure was very selfish because she didn't want to share her things with her best friend, Chloe. She kept all of her toys for herself, even when Chloe asked her nicely.
One day, Laure and Chloe were playing a game, but Laure wouldn't let Chloe win. Chloe felt so sad that she started to cry. Laure felt bad for being so selfish, so she hugged Chloe and promised to share her things with her.
Chloe stopped crying, but Laure started to weep because she was so sorry for hurting her friend. Chloe gave Laure a big hug and said it was okay, and they hugged until they both felt much better. 
From then on, Laure promised that she would never be selfish again, and both girls could play together forever.

Once upon a time, in a small forest, there was a unique frog named Lily. Lily was not like the other frogs. She had a very pretty color and a special gift. She could tell if something was poison or not.
One day, Lily saw a big, red fruit. She knew that this fruit was poison. She told all her friends in the forest, "Do not eat this fruit. It is poison." But some of the animals did not listen to Lily.
A little rabbit named Timmy did not believe Lily. He thought she was telling a lie. So, Timmy ate the red fruit. Soon, he felt very sick. Lily and the other animals helped Timmy get better.
After that day, all the animals in the forest learned to listen to Lily. They knew she was not telling a lie. They also learned to be careful of poison. The moral of the story is: always listen to those who know more than you and do not think they are lying.

Sally was sitting in her room and looking out the window. She was sad because her mommy had told her to stay inside and play by herself. She wanted to go to the grocery store to get something yummy.
Suddenly, Sally heard a slow knock on her door. It was her mommy. She said, “Sally, how about if we go to the grocery store? Let’s get something special for dinner!”
Sally was so happy. She quickly put on her shoes and ran down the stairs and outside. They slowly drove to the grocery store. On the way, her mommy told Sally about all the different things they could buy.
When they arrived, Sally saw all the different colors, shapes, and smells. She wanted everything! But her mommy told her to be slow and pick just one thing.
Sally saw some yummy ice cream and decided to get it. As they drove home, Sally’s mommy told her stories about the neighborhood and the stars in the sky.
When they got home, Sally’s mommy and daddy enjoyed the ice cream and smiled at Sally. It was a great day!

Once upon a time, there was a big furry bear. He liked to sit in the sun and feel the warm rays on his fur. One day, he saw some clothes hanging on a clothesline. The clothes were colorful and bright. The bear wanted to try them on, so he sat down and put them on. He looked silly in the clothes, but he didn't care. He was having fun!

Lily and Sam liked to go to the park with their mom. They liked to play on the swings, slide down the slide, and run on the grass. Sometimes, they also liked to buy ice cream from the vendor. The vendor was a nice man who had a big cart with many flavors of ice cream.
One day, they went to the park and saw the vendor. They ran to him and asked for ice cream. But there was a problem. There was a big dog next to the cart. The dog was barking and growling. It did not let anyone get close to the cart. It wanted to eat all the ice cream.
The vendor was scared of the dog. He tried to shoo it away, but it did not listen. He tried to call for help, but no one heard him. He did not know what to do. The dog was preventing him from selling ice cream.
Lily and Sam were sad and impatient. They really wanted ice cream. They did not like the dog. They wished it would go away. They looked around and saw a stick. They had an idea. They picked up the stick and threw it far away. The dog saw the stick and ran after it. It forgot about the ice cream.
The vendor was happy and relieved. He thanked Lily and Sam for their help. He gave them each a big scoop of ice cream. They chose their favorite flavors. They licked their ice cream and smiled. They were glad they could prevent the dog from ruining their fun. They enjoyed their ice cream and their day at the park.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys. One day, he saw a large ball in the park. 
Timmy: "Wow! That ball is so big! I want to play with it."
A little girl named Sarah was playing with the ball. 
Timmy: "Can I play with your ball, please?"
Sarah: "Sure! I love sharing my toys with others."
Timmy was so happy to play with the large ball. He kicked it and threw it in the air. Sarah and Timmy played together for a long time. 
Timmy: "Thank you for sharing your ball with me. I had so much fun playing with you."
Sarah: "You're welcome! I love making new friends." 
From that day on, Timmy and Sarah played together often and became the best of friends.

Once upon a time, there was an elderly lady who loved oranges. She would count them every day to make sure she had enough. One day, a little boy came to her house and saw all the oranges. He asked, "Why do you have so many oranges?"
The elderly lady replied, "I love oranges. They are sweet and juicy. I like to count them every day."
The little boy asked, "Can I count them too?"
The elderly lady smiled and said, "Of course, you can count them with me."
So, the little boy and the elderly lady counted all the oranges together. They had so much fun that the little boy came back every day to count oranges with the elderly lady. They became good friends and enjoyed each other's company.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to go on journeys with her mommy and daddy. One day, they decided to go on a journey to a big green forest. 
As they walked through the forest, Lily looked around and saw many trees and animals. She saw a big brown bear and a little green frog. 
"Look, mommy! A frog!" Lily said.
"Yes, Lily. It's a little green frog," her mommy replied.
After a while, they came to a beautiful waterfall. Lily loved the sound of the water falling down. 
"This journey is so much fun!" Lily said.
"I'm glad you're having a good time, sweetie," her daddy said. 
After a long day of walking, they went back home. Lily was tired but happy from her journey in the green forest.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to run and play outside. One day, he put on his favorite shoes and went outside to play. Suddenly, he saw a butterfly and started to chase it. 
As he was running, he felt his shoe spring loose and fall off. He stopped and looked at his shoe. It was serious - the lace had come untied! Timmy didn't know how to tie his shoes yet, so he sat down and tried to fix it. 
Just then, his mom came outside and saw him struggling. She smiled and showed him how to tie his shoe. Timmy was so happy and ran around, feeling proud of himself for learning something new. From then on, he made sure to always tie his shoes before going outside to play.

Once upon a time there was a princess who lived in a castle. One day she was walking close to the beach when she heard a sound coming from the ocean. She looked out and saw a little dog in the water. He was very nervous and he was swimming close to the shore but he just couldn't get out.
The princess knew she had to rescue him so she wasted no time. She quickly called out to the little dog and he looked over at her with wide eyes. She then picked him up with both hands and carried him back to the beach.
The princess and the dog both smiled in relief, but the princess still had to figure out where the dog came from. She sat down on the sand near a tall palm tree and the dog sat by her side. Suddenly, a boy appeared and he ran up to her and hugged the dog. He was so happy to see his puppy again! 
The princess said goodbye to the happy boy and the dog, then walked back to her castle, feeling very satisfied. She was glad she was able to rescue the little dog and return him to his owner.

Once upon a time, there was a girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and her favorite toy was a rare teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom told her that they needed to deliver some cookies to their neighbor who was sick. Lily was sad because she wanted to play with her toys, but her mom said it was important to help others.
So, they got into their car and drove to the neighbor's house. When they arrived, the neighbor was very happy to see them and thanked them for the cookies. Lily felt happy too because she helped someone who needed it. She realized that it was better to help others than to play with her toys all day.
From that day on, Lily tried to help others whenever she could. She learned that it was important to be kind and to deliver happiness to those around her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Sue. Sue loved to play with bubbles. One sunny day, she went outside to blow some bubbles with her bubble wand.
Sue blew a big, graceful bubble. The bubble floated up into the sky. Sue wanted to see where the bubble would go, so she decided to follow it. She ran and skipped as the bubble danced in the wind.
The bubble led Sue to a beautiful park with lots of flowers. Sue felt happy and laughed as she played with the bubble. She knew that she would remember this special day forever.

Once upon a time, there was a clumsy monkey named Max. Max loved to play games with his friends in the jungle. One day, they decided to play a game of tag. Max was so excited to play that he forgot to watch where he was going and tripped over a rock.
Max's friends laughed and teased him, but Max didn't mind. He got up and kept playing. However, during the game, Max accidentally bit his friend's tail. His friend was very upset and ran away crying. Max felt terrible and realized that he needed to be more careful when playing games.
From that day on, Max made sure to watch where he was going and to be more careful when playing with his friends. He also learned that it's important to apologize when you make a mistake and to be kind to others. Max and his friend made up and continued to play games together, but this time, Max made sure to be extra careful not to bite anyone again.

Once there was a baby. Her name was Lucy. She was very small and loved to eat. Everyday, she ate lots of food. One day, she was playing in the garden. It was a very wide garden full of flowers and trees.
Suddenly, she fell and hurt her knee. She started to cry. It hurt a lot. Her mom came running and picked Lucy up. She gave Lucy a big hug and kissed her knee. 
Lucy felt much better. But now she was very hungry. Her mom gave her some yummy food to eat. She ate it up quickly and felt much better. She touched her knee and it didn't hurt anymore. 
Lucy went back out into the wide garden, feeling happy and not scared of falling anymore. She was sure that her mom would always be there to take care of her.

Once upon a time in a small town, there was a kind and humble man named Tom. He had a big, strong house made of steel. Tom liked to help everyone in the town.
One day, a little girl named Sue came to Tom's house. She looked sad. "Tom, can you help me find my lost toy?" she asked. Tom smiled and nodded. "Yes, Sue, I will help you."
They looked everywhere for the toy. They looked under the trees and behind the bushes. Finally, they found the toy near the river. Sue was very happy. She said, "Thank you, Tom!" Tom nodded and smiled. They went back to the town, and everyone was happy.

Once upon a time there were two friends, Tony and Fred. They were best buddies and always did things together. One day, Tony said to Fred, "Hey, let's have an adventure!"
Fred said, "Yeah, let's do it!" So they set off into the woods. After a long walk, Tony said, "Let's settle here for a bit and have a picnic."
When they sat down and opened their picnic basket, there was cheese! Yum, thought Tony. They each had some cheese; it was bitter but Tony still liked it. Fred thought it was too bitter and didn't want to eat it.
Tony said, "Come on, Fred, it's not that bad!" Tony had another bit and he thought it tasted great! So eventually, Fred tried it and the two of them ate the cheese and enjoyed their picnic.
The two friends laughed and hugged each other, glad that they had enjoyed the cheese together. And they settled there, in the woods, enjoying their adventure.

Bernie and his mom were walking in the park. Bernie asked his mom if they could buy pasta. His mom nodded and they ran to the store. When they got there, Bernie was excited to pick out his favorite type of pasta. He whispered to his mom to get the regular kind. 
They got back home and Bernie's mom started cooking the pasta. The smell of the cooking pasta made Bernie's stomach growl. Bernie sat at the table, waiting for his mom to call him to dinner. But after a few minutes, Bernie heard his mom whisper something. 
Bernie asked his mom what she said. She sadly said that the pasta was not cooked yet. Bernie was sad, but they both decided to wait. Soon, they heard a loud boom and the lights in the house went out. 
Bernie's mom quickly said they should stay away from the stove. They had to wait in the dark until the lights came back on. Bernie was tired and tired and ready to eat the pasta. But when the lights came back on, the pasta was overcooked and ruined. 
Bernie and his mom had to throw out all the ruined pasta. Bernie was so upset that he had to go to bed without dinner. And even though Bernie tried to be regular when it came to food, he still went to bed hungry.

Once upon a time there was a little girl named Jenny who loved spending time outside. One day Jenny found a boat by the river and couldn't wait to explore. She said excitedly "I'm going in the boat."
As she jumped inside and grabbed the oars, her dad said, "Be careful Jenny, and enjoy your journey!" 
Jenny began to row and soon the river started to move with her. She felt the breeze on her face and the sun on her skin. She was so excited that she rowed until the river seemed to be standing still.
Suddenly Jenny heard an owl call out. It was so lazy and relaxing, just like the boat, that Jenny stopped rowing and lay down in the boat. The river moved slowly and Jenny watched the clouds and the birds flying above. She felt so happy and content. As she lay there, she enjoyed the calmness, like she was in a dream.
At sunset, Jenny's dad found her still lying in the boat, smiling away. He said, "Have you enjoyed your journey? Come on, little one, let's go home now." 
Jenny nodded, feeling tired but happy. She smiled as the boat slowly moved back towards the shore.

Once upon a time there was an old wise whale. Every day the whale would swim around in the ocean looking for food and friends, but no one was around.
At night, the whale would get tired, so it decided to sleep. But it didn't have anywhere to sleep, so it just floated where the waves took it.
For many weeks, the whale floated and slept without ever finding a safe place to rest. It was so lonely and sad.
But one night, something amazing happened. A small school of fishes swam up to the whale and showed it a place to sleep. The whale was so happy and he followed the fishes to a quiet, dark and warm cave.
The whale felt so safe and happy that he fell asleep right away. For the first time ever, the wise old whale felt safe and at home.

Once there was a little girl. She was only three years old, but she had a huge diary. She carried it around wherever she went. One day, the little girl wanted to turn the pages of her diary. She placed her hands on the cover and slowly turned it. She was amazed as she saw how many pages were inside. She smiled and looked around. Everyone was looking at her and smiling. But then she had a thought. She wanted to turn the pages even more! She was so excited to read what was inside the diary. So she grabbed her diary and started to turn the pages quickly. She couldn't help but smile, because the diary was so huge. She kept turning and turning the pages until she found something she liked. That day was a very special day for the little girl and her huge diary.

Once upon a time there was a great corn farm. Every day, Farmer Tucker worked to make the corn grow. One day, after a long day of working in the sun, Farmer Tucker became very tired. He decided to take a nap in the shade of a big oak tree.
When Farmer Tucker began to fall asleep, he heard a rustling in the corn field. Farmer Tucker opened his eyes to see what was happening. Much to his surprise, Farmer Tucker saw a family of raccoons munching on the corn! Farmer Tucker shouted and clapped his hands and the family of raccoons scampered away.
Farmer Tucker was relieved, but still very tired. He decided to take another nap, but this time he made sure to lock up the corn nice and tight. He lay down under the big oak tree and before he knew it, he was fast asleep.
After a long nap, Farmer Tucker felt refreshed and ready to go back to work. He was surprised to find that the family of raccoons hadn't done too much damage after all. Farmer Tucker smiled, thanking his lucky stars for great corn fields.

Once upon a time there was a boy who was brave and strong. He was always looking for ways to help people and have fun. 
One day he saw a pole in the field. He dared himself to climb the pole. He grabbed onto it, but it was very tall and he couldn't reach the top. 
He looked around and saw a ladder. It was very dull and made of wood, but it was tall enough to help him reach the top of the pole. He grabbed onto it and bravely started to climb. 
Slowly and steadily, he went higher and higher. He reached the top of the pole and smiled with pride. He had done it! He felt so happy and brave. 
He had taken a daring challenge, and he had succeeded. He was a hero!

Once upon a time, there was a big boat. The boat had a big anchor that kept it in one place. The boat was owned by a bald man named Jack. Jack loved to sail on his boat and he often took his friends with him.
One day, Jack's friend Tom came to visit him. Tom wanted to go on a sail with Jack. Jack said, "Sure, you can come with me but you have to allow me to steer the boat." Tom said, "Okay, I will let you steer the boat."
As they sailed, Jack noticed that the anchor was not working properly. He said to Tom, "Can you please check the anchor and see if it is okay?" Tom checked the anchor and found that it was broken. Jack said, "We cannot sail without the anchor. We need to fix it first."
Tom said, "I know a man who can fix it. Let me call him." The man came and fixed the anchor. Jack was happy and said, "Thank you, Tom. You are a good friend. Now, we can sail again."

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, she went to the park with her mommy and daddy. They brought a big bottle of sauce for their picnic lunch. Lily loved sauce, especially the thick kind that was her favorite.
As they were eating, Lily saw a big puddle of water nearby. She wanted to jump in it and splash around, but her mommy said no. "You'll get all wet and dirty," she said. Lily was sad, but she listened to her mommy.
After lunch, they went for a walk around the park. Lily saw a fountain in the distance and got excited. "Can we go there?" she asked her daddy. He said yes, and they walked over to the fountain.
When they got there, Lily saw that the water was spraying up high into the air. She knew what she wanted to do. She ran over to the fountain and jumped right in, splashing water everywhere. Her mommy and daddy laughed and joined in too.
As they were playing, Lily's daddy accidentally knocked over the bottle of sauce. It spilled all over the ground, making a big mess. But Lily didn't mind. She was having too much fun splashing in the fountain. And after all, she still had her favorite thick sauce to eat for lunch.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She went to a big classroom every day. One day, Lily went outside to play in the snow. It was very icy and cold. She sat down on a big rock to rest. Suddenly, she saw a little bird sitting on a branch. The bird looked very cold and sad. So, Lily decided to take the bird inside her classroom to keep it warm. The bird was very happy and chirped all day long. From that day on, Lily and the bird became best friends. The end.

Anna and Ben are playing in the park. They like to swing, slide and run. They are very happy and laugh a lot.
"Look, Anna, I can swing very high!" Ben says. He pushes his legs and goes up and down.
"Wow, Ben, you are very good!" Anna says. She swings too, but not as high as Ben.
Suddenly, they hear a loud noise. It sounds like a big bang. They stop swinging and look around.
"What is that?" Anna asks.
"I don't know. Let's go and see!" Ben says.
They jump off the swings and run to the noise. They see a big truck. The truck has a lot of boxes. One of the boxes has fallen from the truck and broken on the ground. There are books and papers everywhere.
"Oops!" Ben says.
"Who did that?" Anna asks.
A man comes out of the truck. He looks angry and sad. He sees the box and the books and papers.
"Oh no! This is my box! It has all my work in it!" he says.
He picks up some of the papers and looks at them. They have a lot of words and numbers that Anna and Ben don't understand.
"What is your work?" Ben asks.
"I am a teacher. I teach big kids about science and math. These are my notes and tests. They are very important. But now they are all ruined!" the man says.
He sighs and shakes his head.
"I'm sorry, mister," Anna says.
"Can we help you?" Ben asks.
The man looks at Anna and Ben. He sees their curious and kind faces. He smiles a little.
"Thank you, kids. You are very sweet. And very intelligent. You want to learn new things. That's good. Maybe you can help me. Can you help me pick up the books and papers and put them back in the box?" he asks.
"Sure, we can!" Anna and Ben say.
They start to help the man. They pick up the books and papers and put them in the box. They are careful not to tear or bend them. They work together and have fun.
The man is happy and grateful. He thanks Anna and Ben for their help. He gives them each a book. The books have pictures and stories about animals and plants.
"These are for you. You can read them and learn more about science and math. You are very smart kids. I hope you enjoy them," he says.
"Thank you, mister!" Anna and Ben say.
They hug the man and say goodbye. They take their books and run back to the swings. They are very excited and proud. They have helped someone and learned something new. They are very happy and laugh a lot.

Once upon a time there was a compassionate owl who lived in the forest. She was beloved by all the woodland creatures, who she helped when they were in need.
One day, a bully fox came to the forest and started to sack food from the other animals. The owl was very angry and tried to stop him but the fox was too strong.
The owl thought hard and came up with a plan. She pretended to be a friend and asked the fox to go hunting with her. The fox agreed and when they were in the forest the owl showed the fox her compassion. She revealed her true identity and explained how the fox had caused so much damage to the others.
The fox felt bad and realized his mistakes. He asked the owl to forgive him and promised to never sack again. The owl was happy that her compassionate words had made a difference. From then on the fox was a changed animal and the forest was peaceful once more.

Sara and her family moved to a new house. They drove a long time in their big automobile. Sara was tired and bored. She wanted to play with her toys and see her friends.
When they got to the new house, Sara saw a lot of boxes. Her mom and dad said they had to unpack them. Sara did not like unpacking. It was hard and boring. She wanted to play with her toys and see her friends.
Sara saw a box with her name on it. She opened it and found her favorite doll, Lily. She hugged Lily and smiled. She was happy to see her. She wanted to play with her and see her friends.
Sara saw a girl next door. She was about her age and had curly hair. She was playing with a ball. Sara wanted to play with her and see her friends.
Sara asked her mom if she could go and say hi. Her mom said yes, but be careful and polite. Sara took Lily and ran to the girl. She said hi and asked her name. The girl said her name was Mia. She smiled and asked Sara if she wanted to play. Sara said yes and thanked her. Mia was compassionate. She shared her ball and played with Lily. Sara was happy. She made a new friend. She still wanted to see her old friends, but she felt better. She liked her new house. She liked unpacking.

Once upon a time there was a mister. He was very independent and strong. He didn't need help from anyone. He was able to support himself.
One day, while he was walking along the river, he saw a lot of mist. It looked like a cloud but it was lower to the ground. He was curious so he got closer to it.
Inside the mist, he saw a lot of animals enjoying themselves. It made him really happy. He wanted to help them, so he decided to support them.
He started to give the animals food and water. He made sure they were always safe and secure. He was proud to be able to support them.
And from then on, he always supported them whenever he could. That made them very happy and they thanked him for being so independent.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to eat yummy food, especially ice cream. One day, Lily went to the store with her mommy to buy some ice cream. 
Lily saw a big object in the store and asked her mommy, "What is that?" Her mommy said, "It's a toy for big kids. We can't buy it today." 
Lily was sad, but her mommy said they could still get ice cream. They went to the ice cream section and Lily picked out her favorite flavor. When they went to pay, Lily asked her mommy if she could pay. Her mommy gave her some money and Lily gave it to the cashier. 
The cashier smiled and gave Lily her change. Lily was so happy to have her yummy ice cream and to have paid for it herself. She told her mommy, "I paid for it!" and her mommy was proud of her.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very excited to go to her grandma's house. She packed her bag and went to the car with her mom and dad. They drove for a long time and finally arrived at grandma's house.
When they got inside, Lily saw a big cupboard in the kitchen. She asked her grandma, "What's in the cupboard?" Her grandma replied, "That's where I keep all my dishes and cups."
Lily was grateful when her grandma gave her a cup to drink from. She said, "Thank you, grandma! This cup is so pretty." They all sat down and had some cookies and milk. Lily was very happy to be with her family and couldn't wait to come back again.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily liked to play outside in the rain. She would jump in puddles and get very wet. One day, Lily found a big, flexible rubber band on the ground. She picked it up and held it in her hand. 
Lily started to play with the rubber band, stretching it and letting it go. She liked how it felt in her hands. Suddenly, the rubber band slipped out of her hand and flew into a puddle. It got wet and Lily had to fish it out. 
Lily was sad that her rubber band got wet, but she still liked to hold it. She decided to take it inside and dry it off. Now, Lily keeps her rubber band safe and dry, and she loves to hold it and play with it every day. The end.

Once upon a time there was a river that flowed through the land. Source of life, the river was special for all the creatures that called it home.
Each day, the sun would shine bright, and the river glittered like diamonds in the summer sky. But one day the sun shone so much that the river water became shallow. All the little fish, turtles and frogs that lived in it could no longer stay in it because their homes were freshly exposed!
The animals were very scared and did not know what to do. That’s when they saw a big sea turtle, much bigger than any of them, walking on the river’s sandy bottom. The big turtle called out to them: “Children, don’t worry. Follow me in a row and I will show you the way to a deep part of the river.”
The animals did as they were told and the big turtle lead them to a much deeper part of the river where they could all find shelter and safety. 
The moral of this story is that we should help others when they need our help, just like the big turtle did for the animals. We should never forget to shine our light onto others to help them along their journey.

Jack was a brave little boy who loved to climb. Jack had to go to the park every week with his tutor. One day when he got there, he thought it looked like the perfect place to climb. He saw a big tree and asked his tutor if he could climb it.
His tutor said that it looked dangerous, so Jack had to think of something else. He saw a slide and said that he wanted to climb that instead. His tutor said that it was ok, so Jack ran to the slide.
Jack had so much fun climbing the slide that he almost forgot he was with his tutor. He made it all the way to the top and shouted with joy. His tutor then reminded him to be careful and not to do anything dangerous.
Jack agreed and made his way back down the slide. He ran off to play, still with a smile on his face from his fun climb!

Once there was a wolf. He was very clean - he had just had a bath. He was so happy that he decided to go for a bounce! He jumped up high and waggled from side to side. He bounced really high and then low. He spun and jumped and bounced around until he was too tired.
As the wolf relaxed, he saw a butterfly. Its wings were so beautiful and colourful. He wanted to bounce with it. So he went over and said hello. The butterfly said hello back and then flew away. The wolf watched it go as he bounced and twirled behind it.
The wolf had so much fun bouncing around with the butterfly. He wished the fun would never end. But eventually he got too tired, so he had to go home. He carried on bouncing until he got home.
The wolf was so tired, but he was also happy. He was clean and had had a wonderful time bouncing with the butterfly. He snuggled down and tried to remember every second of his adventure. What a wonderful day!

Lily and Max were playing in the park. They liked to search for shiny things in the sand. Sometimes they found coins, buttons, or beads. They put them in their pockets and showed them to their mom.
One day, they saw something very shiny in the sand. It was a gem. It was orange and sparkled in the sun. Lily and Max ran to pick it up.
"Wow, look at this!" Lily said. "It is so pretty!"
"Can I see?" Max asked. He reached for the gem, but Lily held it tight.
"No, it is mine!" Lily said. "I saw it first!"
"But I want to see it too!" Max said. He tried to grab the gem, but Lily pulled it away.
They started to fight over the gem. They pulled and pushed and shouted. They did not see the big dog that came near them. The dog saw the gem and thought it was a ball. He barked and jumped and snatched the gem from Lily's hand. He ran away with it in his mouth.
Lily and Max stopped fighting. They looked at the dog and the gem. They felt sad and sorry.
"Come back!" Lily cried. "That is our gem!"
"Bad dog!" Max yelled. "Give it back!"
But the dog did not listen. He ran to his owner and wagged his tail. He dropped the gem at his feet and licked his face.
Lily and Max ran after the dog. They tried to get their gem back, but the owner picked it up and put it in his pocket.
"Sorry, kids," he said. "This is my dog's toy. He likes shiny things too."
He walked away with the dog and the gem. Lily and Max looked at each other. They felt sad and angry.
They hugged each other and said sorry. They decided to share their other shiny things. They went back to the sand and searched for more. They hoped to find another gem someday.

Once there was a baby who loved to sleep. Every night, the baby would crawl into bed, close her eyes and go to sleep. But one night, the baby woke up feeling scared. Something smelly was in the room! 
The baby listened carefully and heard a noise coming from the corner. Suddenly, the baby saw something turn and she screamed! It was a mouse!
The baby quickly hid under the covers and the little mouse ran away. After that, the baby felt safe and went back to sleep. And the next morning, the baby woke up feeling happy and not so scared of the smelly mouse!

Timmy was an active three year old. He enjoyed playing outside in the sun. One day, he went out and found something dull in his hand. It looked like a funny rock. He enjoyed feeling its rough surface. He twirled it around and around in his hands. 
The rock had a funny smell and Timmy thought it was special. He enjoyed picking it up and moving it close to his face. He looked at it for a long time, imagining all kinds of shapes and colours. 
Finally, he put it in his pocket and ran to tell his mum. She said the rock was an old fossil. Timmy smiled and said that he would always enjoy keeping it with him.

Once upon a time, there was a big, fat bear named Coal. Coal loved to eat honey and berries, but one day he ate too much and felt very full. He sighed and decided to take a nap. While he was sleeping, some mischievous squirrels snuck into his cave and stole his honey. When Coal woke up, he was sad and hungry. He looked everywhere for his honey but couldn't find it. Finally, he asked a friendly rabbit for help. The rabbit showed Coal where the squirrels had hidden the honey and Coal was very happy again. From then on, Coal learned to only eat a little bit of honey at a time so he wouldn't feel so full and sleepy.

Johnny was walking in the park with his uncle. They were enjoying the sunny day and the birds singing. Johnny looked at the tall grass swaying in the wind and smiled. Suddenly, he saw a tough looking bird near a bush. He stopped and gazed at the bird in amazement.
His uncle kneeled down and said, "That's an eagle, Johnny. How cool does he look?" Johnny smiled and kept staring at the majestic bird. They spent the time together just looking at the eagle. 
"Let's keep going, Johnny," said his uncle after some time. Johnny reluctantly took his uncle's hand and they continued walking. Johnny was still day dreaming about the eagle as they walked out of the park.

Henry stared at the wagon. It was big, red and filled with toys. He was impatient to go for a ride. He pulled at it but it wouldn't move. He shouted for help. 
His mom came running over. She put him in the wagon and held the handle. Henry smiled and shouted with joy.
The wagon began to move. Henry watched the houses and trees go by. He waved at some kids he saw playing in a garden.
Suddenly, the wagon stopped. Henry stared ahead. There was an ice cream shop! His mom took out some money and promised him a treat. Henry smiled and was no longer impatient.

Once there was a cute little bunny. Every day it hopped around, looking for things to nibble on. But one day it saw something it really liked. It was a small red ball. 
The bunny hopped over and grabbed the ball. Then it used all its speed and threw the ball as high as it could into the air. The ball went so high that the bunny could hardly see it. 
The ball came down a few minutes later and the bunny caught it. Then it threw the ball again. This time it flew even higher than before. The bunny was so excited. 
The bunny kept throwing and catching the ball until the sun started to set. Then the bunny hopped away with its red ball, ready to play again tomorrow.

Once upon a time, there was a lucky jeep. Every day, the jeep liked to dress up in its best clothes. It wore bright red boots, a yellow scarf and a sparkly blue hat. Everywhere the jeep went, it was admired by everyone. 
One day, the lucky jeep heard about a race and decided it wanted to join in. So the jeep dressed up in its racing outfit - a red and yellow racing suit with white stripes. It drove off feeling excited and super fast. 
The lucky jeep raced past the other cars and was the first to reach the finish line! Everyone cheered for the lucky jeep. It had won the race and was so proud of its accomplishment. 
The jeep had had a lucky day and couldn't wait to dress up again in all its clothes and show off to everyone.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy had a toy robot that he loved to play with. One day, Timmy accidentally broke his robot and it stopped working. Timmy was sad because his robot was his favorite toy.
Timmy's mom told him not to worry because she knew someone who could fix the robot. She took the robot to a man who had a reliable repair shop. The man used a special tool called a laser to fix the robot. Timmy was amazed to see the robot working again.
When Timmy asked the man how he fixed the robot, the man explained that he used the laser to shrink the broken parts back to their original size. Timmy was so happy to have his favorite toy back and he thanked the man for fixing it.

Once there was a cool battery. It was his birthday and he sat on the shelf, waiting for the surprise. But he couldn't see what was happening.
He could hear some sounds outside. His curiosity made him peek out of the shelf.
He saw a lot of little friends, all playing around. They were singing and shouting and dancing. He wanted to join them.
He started to bounce up and down, but then he remembered he was stuck on the shelf. So he just peered out, watching the fun.
Suddenly, a huge box appeared! He was so excited! He wanted to know what was inside, but he couldn't get his peepers to see.
Then he remembered something very important - he had an on / off switch! He switched it on and peered inside the box.
And there it was - a big cake with lots of colour and sparkles. All the little friends were singing "Happy Birthday" to him!
He was so happy that he tried to bounce again, but he realised he was still stuck on the shelf. Well at least he could peek out and make sure that everyone was having fun!

Once upon a time, there was a large ranch. In the ranch, there lived two children: Tom and Susie. One day, Tom and Susie were walking in the ranch. Suddenly, Tom said to Susie, "Let's dance!" 
Susie smiled and said, "Yes! That sounds like fun!"
Tom and Susie started dancing around the large ranch. They jumped and twirled in the warm sun. All the animals grazing on the ranch stopped to watch them.
On and on they danced until they were too tired to dance anymore. After a while, Susie said, "That was so much fun! Let's do it again soon!"
Tom smiled and said, "Yes, let's do it! It was a great way to spend the day!" 
And that is how Tom and Susie spent their day: dancing in the large ranch!

John loved to play in the pond. Every day he splashed around, feeling the cool water and smiling at all the fish he could see. John saw the shadow of a big bird fly past and he knew something special was about to happen.
He started to swim deeper into the pond and when he looked up, he saw a dragon! John was so scared he forgot how to swim and he started to sink. The dragon came closer and closer and John was too scared to move.
The dragon took one last deep breath and breathed fire over John. He screamed, but it was too late. Everything went dark and the dragon flew away.
The other children had seen what had happened and they were all in shock. Nothing like this had ever happened before, it was definitely not normal. The pond was quiet and dark now and nobody felt like splashing around anymore.

Max was a three year old boy. He loved to play with his friends. One day, he was playing when the school principal suddenly came in. Everyone got scared and stood still.
"Who made these big messes?" the principal asked. The little kids stayed quiet.
Max was embarrassed. He knew that he had made the mess. Tears filled his eyes and he started to weep.
The principal crossed her arms and said, "Come here, Max. We'll have to tell your parents."
Max was so embarrassed that he could no longer stop weeping. His friends felt sorry for him. The principal took Max's hand and walked him to his parents.
Max's parents were very angry. They scolded him and made him clean up his mess. Max was so embarrassed and could not stop weeping.
Max's friends saw that he was so sad. They all wept together sadly. Max never wanted to make a mess again and felt embarrassed whenever he thought of that day.

Once there was a little girl called Daisy. She was three years old. One day, Daisy and her family went out for dinner. Daisy was very tired when they arrived at the restaurant.
When Daisy's food arrived, she realised that she had forgotten to bring a napkin. She began to look around the restaurant and act very worried. Her dad then came over and gave Daisy a big napkin to use! Daisy was very happy and gave her dad a big smile. 
After finishing her dinner, Daisy was feeling much better and more energetic. She acted up and ran around the restaurant, making everyone laugh. 
Daisy's dad was very happy to see his daughter feeling more lively. He gave Daisy the napkin and said, "Let's go home now so you can get a nice rest!" Daisy smiled, kissed her dad, and ran to the car.

Once upon a time, there was a fat squirrel. He loved to eat nuts and seeds. One day, he wanted to prepare for winter. He gathered lots of nuts and put them in his tree house. The squirrel was happy because he knew he would have enough food to eat during the cold winter months.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a smart dog named Max. Max was very clever and knew many tricks. One day, Lily and Max went for a walk in the park. They saw a big, dark cloud in the sky. Lily said, "Look, Max! The sky is dark." Max barked and wagged his tail. Suddenly, it started to rain. Lily and Max ran under a tree to stay dry. They waited until the rain stopped and then went back home. From that day on, Lily always remembered to bring an umbrella when she went for a walk with Max.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys and eat candy. One day, her mommy asked her to clean up her toys. Lily didn't want to, but she knew it was the right thing to do.
As she was cleaning, she realized that she had lost her favorite toy. She looked everywhere but couldn't find it. She started to cry and told her mommy what happened. Her mommy was very kind and helped her look for it.
After a while, they found the toy under the bed. Lily was so happy and gave her mommy a big hug. "Thank you for helping me find my toy," she said. "Of course, sweetie," her mommy replied. "Remember, it's important to keep your things in order so you don't lose them." Lily nodded and promised to always keep her toys in order.

Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat sandwiches from the subway. He would ask his mom to take him there every week. 
One day, Timmy saw his friend Billy eating a big sandwich. Timmy asked, "Billy, where did you get that big sandwich?" 
"I made it myself," said Billy. "I own a sandwich maker. It helps me make sandwiches that fit perfectly in my tummy." 
Timmy was amazed. He wanted to own a sandwich maker too so he could make big sandwiches like Billy. So, Timmy asked his mom to buy him a sandwich maker. And from that day on, Timmy made his own sandwiches that fit perfectly in his tummy, just like Billy.

Once upon a time, there was a boy. His name was Jack. He was very sad and miserable. 
One day, Jack heard a talking coming from outside. He went to the exit to see who it was. When he arrived, he saw two people - a prince and a princess. They were talking about marriage. 
Jack asked them, "What's marry?"
The prince answered, "Marriage is when two people love each other so much, they want to be together forever. They promise to always believe and trust in each other and make each other happy."
The princess held the prince's hand and said, "I am marrying you so that I'll never be miserable again."
Jack smiled. He realized that he could be happy too and he ran away, feeling much less miserable.

One day, Mommy had to go out to buy something. She told Tommy to wait for her at home.
Tommy was happy to stay home, but he was also a little bit scared. It was so gloomy out, and without Mommy, the house felt empty.
So, Tommy did something he hadn't ever done before: he decided to buy a cell phone. He wanted to have a way to call Mommy if he got scared.
He went to the store and found the perfect cell phone. He was so proud! He took it to the cashier, and with his pocket money, he bought it.
When Mommy came home, Tommy showed her the cell phone. Mommy was so surprised and proud. She told Tommy how smart he was for buying a cell phone.
Tommy was so happy to have the cell phone, and he was never afraid when Mommy was away again.

Once upon a time there was a fair flea who wanted to find a place to fit. He looked left, he looked right, but he couldn't find a spot that was just right. He flew up high in the sky and he flew low and all around, but he just couldn't find a place to fit. He began to get very tired and he was about to give up when he saw a big dog, stretching and laying in the sun. The fair flea watched for a bit and, when the big dog stood up and started running around, a space was formed between his shoulders. The flea flew in quickly, putting himself in just the right spot! He fit perfectly and from that spot he could see everything. And so the fair flea found his place and he was very happy. The end.

Once upon a time there was a scary sink. One day, a surprise happened. The sink opened and a big monster came out! He was green and had big spiky teeth. He was so scary that the people screamed. Everyone ran away and hid. But then something amazing happened. A brave little girl stepped up and faced the monster. She headed towards the monster and put her hands on her hips. The monster smiled and gave her a big hug. Everyone was so excited and happy that the brave girl had saved them all!

Once upon a time there was a girl who was scared. She was scared of the dark and didn't want to go to bed. So, every night she would find her way to the big, comfy couch and huddle there until morning.
One night, she heard a voice from behind the couch. It was a soft, gentle voice and it said, "You don't have to be scared." The girl was so surprised she jumped from the couch.
"Who said that?" she asked.
The voice answered, "It's me. I live behind the couch and I can see you are scared. I want to tell you something to make you feel better."
The girl was still scared but listened to what the voice had to say. The voice told her stories and made her laugh until she forgot all about feeling scared.
The voice said, "Now, it's time for bed. Sweet dreams!" 
And so, the girl went off to bed feeling safe and secure, grateful for the wonderful friendship she had found behind the couch.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved watching movies on his big screen TV. One day, Timmy's mom asked him what movie he wanted to watch. Timmy said, "I want to watch a great movie about dinosaurs!"
So, Timmy's mom put on a movie about dinosaurs. At first, Timmy was excited to see the big, scary dinosaurs on the screen. But then, one of the dinosaurs started to scare him. Timmy said, "Mom, I don't like this movie anymore. The scary dinosaur is making me scared."
Timmy's mom turned off the movie and said, "Don't worry, Timmy. We can watch a different movie. Let's watch a great movie about animals instead." Timmy smiled and said, "Okay, that sounds fun!" And they watched a great movie about animals that didn't scare Timmy at all.

Once there was a mum and her little girl. The mum always took care of her little girl and tried to make her comfortable. The mum would keep her little girl warm and safe. She would hug her and tell her stories. 
The mum took special care of her little girl's skin. She would make sure it was clean and healthy. She put a protective cream on her little girl's skin to make sure it was comfortable.
The little girl always felt so safe with her mum's care. She was so happy and grateful that her mum looked after her so well. The mum and the little girl loved each other very much.

Timmy was on his way to the park with his dad. He had never been there before, so he was excited and filled with wonder. He had never seen a cooler filled with such colorful drinks before. His dad said he could have one, but only if he promised to be responsible.
At the park, Timmy was filled with even more wonder as he saw all the different things there was to do. He wanted to do them all, but his dad said he could only pick one and that he must stay where he could be seen. 
Timmy chose to go on the swings and had so much fun that he almost forgot about the cooler. But then he started to get thirsty and remembered. He asked his dad if he could have one of the drinks, but his dad said no. He said that he wouldn't be responsible if he had one. 
Timmy was so upset that he started to cry. He felt so disappointed and wasn't sure what to do. Suddenly, his dad knelt down, looked him in the eyes and said, "Listen, Timmy. You can have a drink, but only if you promise to be responsible and share with your friends.” Timmy smiled, wiped away his tears and ran off to grab a colorful drink from the cooler!

Once upon a time, there was a big, hot sun in the sky. The sun made everything feel warm and nice. One day, a little rat appeared from behind a tree. The rat was small and brown, with a long tail. It looked around and saw some cheese on the ground. The rat was hungry, so it ran over to the cheese and ate it all up. Then, the rat disappeared back behind the tree. The sun kept shining and everything was happy. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl. She wanted to study and learn lots of things. So every day, she would get her stuff, like her books and pencils, and sit down to study.
Sometimes it would hurt her. The numbers and letters looked hard. But she kept studying and eventually she got better and better.
After awhile, she had learned lots of stuff. She was so proud of herself. Then, she started to teach her friends what she had learned. They all liked learning from her.
The end.

Once upon a time there was a girl named Anne. One day, Anne had a very special wish. She wanted to spin very high in the sky. So, Anne went outside and found a round wheel. She jumped onto the wheel and started to spin round and round. With each spin, Anne went higher and higher into the sky. 
Anne couldn't stop spinning. She spun faster and faster until she reached the sky. Up in the sky, Anne could see all the way to the mountains and the sea. She kept spinning in the sky until the wheel became too weak to spin any more. 
With one last spin, Anne spun high in the sky and then came back down to the ground. Everyone was so surprised to see Anne return to Earth from the sky. From then on, Anne made a wish every day to spin in the sky, but no one ever saw her do it again.

Once upon a time, there was an old shelf in a house. The shelf was very big and it had many things on it. One day, something bad happened. The shelf fell down and all the things on it broke into small pieces. The old shelf was broken too and it could not be fixed. The people in the house were very sad because they lost all their things. The end.

John was walking in a forest. He saw something under a tree. "What is that?" he thought. He wondered what it could be. He came closer and he saw that it was a skull. John was very busy, so he decided to leave the skull and go back later.
The next day, John came back with his family. He wanted to explore more. He came to the place where he had discovered the skull. He said to his mom, "Look! I found this yesterday!" His mom looked at him and said, "Be careful! There might be something dangerous in the forest!"
John continued to explore the forest with his family. Suddenly, they heard loud noises coming from the direction of the skull. They went to look and saw something amazing. The skull had moved and revealed a huge cave! John and his family had discovered something incredible!

Once upon a time there was a baby elephant. He weighed 1000 pounds and lived in the jungle with his mum and dad. Every day the baby elephant went for a walk in the jungle and listened to stories his parents told him about his ancestors. 
One day, the baby elephant's dad told him about a magical lake where baby elephants can talk. The baby elephant was so excited to explore this lake and asked to go. His parents were a bit nervous but agreed. 
When they arrived at the lake, things did not go as expected. The baby elephant didn't know what to do. He felt scared and alone. After some time, he realized he had to go back home. But the lake was too deep and the baby elephant he was too nervous to jump.  His parents had to weigh the options - should they stay or should they go? 
Finally, they decided to leave the magical lake and go back home. The baby elephant was glad they took this decision and promised to never forget the story his dad shared with him.

Once upon a time, there were two friends. One friend had a game that was cheap. The other friend wanted to play with the game too. So they asked their mom if they could repair it.
But their mom said no. She said that the game was too old and it would cost too much money to fix. The friends were sad.
The two friends decided to find a way to fix the game themselves. They worked hard to find a cheap way to repair it.
After looking online and asking their dad for help, the two friends found the parts they needed to repair the game. They put the pieces together and it worked!
Their mom was very happy. She knew that their hard work would pay off! Now the friends can play the game together.

Once upon a time there was a family with two kids. One day, when they were outside, it started to rain hard. The rain came down really fast and soon the ground was all wet. The kids said to their parents, "Look, it's a flood!"
The water was coming up higher and higher and it started to come into the house. The parents were worried and said, "Come on, let's go upstairs so we can be safe." Upstairs, the family watched as the flood water kept coming in. The water was so high that it was touching the roof.
The kids were getting scared and started to cry. Their mom said, "It's okay, sweeties. Everything will be alright." But soon the water kept getting higher and the family had to go outside.
The flood was so strong that it hurt the family. They had to hold onto each other to stay safe. Finally, the flood stopped and the family was safe. The family was so happy to be safe and said, "We made it!"

The sun was shining brightly and the birds were singing happily. It was a beautiful day outside. 
Monica was stirring the pancake batter with a spoon when her friend Sarah came to her house.
"What are you doing now, Monica?" Sarah asked.
"I'm making pancakes for breakfast," Monica said. "Do you want to help me stir?"
"Yes," Sarah said. They both stirred the batter together. 
When they were finished, they looked outside. "It's a beautiful sunny day," said Sarah.
"Yes, and the weather is so nice," replied Monica. Suddenly, she felt a bit guilty. She had wanted rain so that she could stay inside and play. 
"Don't feel guilty," Sarah said. "Let's go out and play in the sunshine."
Monica smiled. "Okay," she said. 
So they went outside to enjoy the nice weather, and didn't feel guilty at all.

Once upon a time, a bird wanted to fly high in the sky. It had pretty feathers and was very graceful. The bird wanted to show off its beauty to all the other animals. So, it took off and flew higher and higher.
But suddenly, a big wind came and the bird couldn't fly anymore. It started to fall down, down, down. A cat saw the bird falling and quickly ran to take it in its paws.
The bird was hurt and couldn't fly anymore. It was very sad and missed flying high in the sky. From that day on, the bird stayed on the ground and never flew again.

Once upon a time, there was a kind girl named Lily. She loved to share her toys with her friends. One day, she decided to invite her friends to her birthday party. She wanted to make them happy and give them gifts. 
Lily's mom took her to the airport to pick up her grandma. When they arrived, Lily saw a boy who looked sad. She went to him and asked what was wrong. The boy said he missed his family and didn't have anyone to play with. Lily felt bad and invited him to her party. 
At the party, Lily gifted her friends with toys and the boy with a big smile. Everyone had fun playing together. Lily learned that sharing and inviting others can make them happy too. From that day on, she always looked for ways to help others and make them feel included.

Once upon a time there were two birds called Jack and Jill. Every night they would collect worms to eat, and they were very happy. 
One day, Jack found a shiny coin on the ground. He wanted to collect it and put it in his nest. But Jill told him, "No, Jack! That coin is not good for you!"
Jack didn't listen to her, and he collected it anyway. But when he tried to fly with it, it was too heavy for him. He started to feel very tired and he couldn't breathe properly. His lungs started to hurt.
Then Jill flew over to Jack, and started to peck at the coin. She said, "If we share the coin, it won't be so heavy for us". So together, Jack and Jill shared the coin and flew back to their nest. 
That night, Jill told Jack, "It's good to be generous and to share what we have. If we don't share, it can be very harsh".
Jack and Jill learned a important lesson that day, and they lived very happily ever after.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily was very enthusiastic about playing with her toys every day. She loved to play with her dolls, her blocks, and her teddy bear. One day, Lily's mom took her to the park to play with other kids. Lily was very happy and excited to play with the other kids.
While playing, Lily saw a little boy who was sad and crying. She went to him and asked, "Why are you crying?" The little boy said, "I lost my toy car, and I can't find it."
