Lily felt sad for the little boy, so she decided to help him. She asked the other kids to help her find the toy car. After a while, they found the toy car stuck in a tree. Lily climbed the tree and released the toy car from the branches.
The little boy was very patient and waited for Lily to find his toy car. He was very happy when he got it back. Lily learned that it's important to help others and be patient when waiting for something. She felt happy that she could make the little boy smile again. From that day on, Lily always tried to help others and be patient when waiting for things. The end.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to eat candy, especially lollipops. One day, Timmy went to the candy store to buy a lollipop. He picked a red one and twisted it in his hand. 
As he walked home, Timmy saw a big, gloomy cloud in the sky. It made him sad. Suddenly, he heard a voice behind him. "That's a yummy lollipop you have there," the voice said. It was his friend, Sally. 
Timmy offered Sally a taste of his lollipop. "It's cherry flavor," he said. Sally took a lick and smiled. "Yum! Thanks, Timmy!" she said. They walked home together, sharing the lollipop and chatting about their day. When they got home, Timmy felt a little less gloomy. He was glad he had shared his candy with his friend.

Once upon a time, there was a girl who had a special suit. Every day, she would lift it up and put it on her body.
One day, the girl was excited to go to the beach. She put on her special suit and was ready to have fun in the sun. But when she arrived at the beach, she noticed that the water was sour. It tasted yucky!
The girl wanted to go for a swim, but she was too scared to get in the water. Then, she had a solution! She took her special suit off and held it in her hands. She was careful not to get it wet in the sour water.
The girl lifted up the suit and ran around the beach. She swished it through the air and used it to fly around like a kite. She had so much fun!
When she was done playing, she put her special suit back on and walked away with a smile. She vowed to always remember her special suit and never forget to lift it up and have fun.

Once there was a mommy and a baby. The baby was very happy, because it was a sunny day. The mommy took the baby for a walk. They went for a walk in the park. The baby saw a pretty butterfly flying in the sky. The baby wanted to try and catch it. But just as the baby was about to run, the mommy said, "Wait!"
The mommy pointed to smoke coming out of the woods. The baby asked, "What is it?" The mommy said, "Let's stay here and be careful." The baby said "OK."
Just then, the baby heard a loud, violent sneeze coming from the smoke! The mommy and baby were both scared! The mommy took the baby's hand and said, "Come on, let's go back home and be safe." The baby agreed and they went back home, happy and safe.

Once there was a famous princess named Penny. She lived in a big castle made of stones and was very happy. Her dream was to marry a prince so that she could be happy forever.
One day, a wily old wizard showed up at the castle and said he could make her dreams come true. He said that if she agreed to marry him, he could make her famous forever. He promised he would be very kind and gentle with her, and that she would always have plenty of money. 
Penny thought about it, but eventually she refused to marry the wizard because he was too old and she knew he would not make her happy forever. She decided to wait until she met a real prince who could make her truly happy.
The wizard was angry at the refusal and so he vanished in a puff of smoke. Penny kept waiting and eventually, the prince she was looking for showed up. 
They married and Penny was very happy. They celebrated their marriage by throwing coins in the air, including one special penny that they kept forever. And with the prince by her side, they both lived happily ever after.

Once upon a time, a cop was walking down the street. He was famous for being the best cop in the town. As he was walking, he saw a sack on the ground. He was curious, so he went to take a closer look. When the cop opened the sack, he found lots of toys and sweets inside. At first, he was very surprised. Then, he had an idea. He decided to take the sack of toys and sweets to a nearby park, where some children were playing. When the kids saw the cop, they were very excited. They asked what was in the sack, and the cop said it was a present for them. The kids couldn't believe it! They thanked the cop and thought he was very kind. They opened the sack, and their faces lit up with joy. They took out all the toys and sweets and shared them with each other. After all the kids had fun, they thanked the cop again. From that day on, the cop became even more famous in the town.

Joe was envious of his older brother, Zac. Zac was so good at math and Joe wanted to be like him. One day, Zac made Joe a promise. He said that if Joe studied math every day he would get better at it. Joe was so excited and he did his best to study every day.
One time, Zac had a test and Joe was really nervous. But Joe was happy when Zac came home with a big smile on his face. Zac had gotten a good mark on his test because of all the math he had studied. Joe was so proud of him.
Eventually, Joe started to get better and better at math everyday. He forgot all about being envious of Zac because he was learning so much. Now both brothers are great at math and they have even started helping each other to study!

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to wear her favorite suit, a pink one with flowers on it. One night, Lily went to bed and started to dream. In her dream, she was flying high in the sky and could see all the stars. Suddenly, she heard a voice saying, "You look so pretty in your suit, Lily." 
Lily turned around and saw a friendly bird who was flying next to her. "Thank you," Lily replied with a smile. "I love my suit." 
The bird then said, "I have a bitter taste in my mouth. Do you know why?" 
Lily thought for a moment and said, "Maybe you ate something that wasn't yummy." 
The bird nodded and said, "You're right. I ate a worm that tasted bitter." 
Lily and the bird continued to fly together in the dream, chatting about their favorite things. When Lily woke up the next morning, she remembered her dream and smiled. She put on her pink suit and went outside to play with her friends, hoping to see the friendly bird again in her dreams.

Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Thomas. One day, he was playing in his bedroom and he found a pretty red bracelet. Thomas was so happy, he wanted to put the bracelet on right away. 
"Mommy, look at the bracelet!" he shouted.
His mother saw the bracelet, and said, "No, Thomas. You can't keep the bracelet. It must belong to someone else."
Thomas was very disappointed. But suddenly, he had an idea. He said to his mother, "Let me keep it for just one day. Please?"
His mother thought about it for a moment, and said, "All right. You can keep the bracelet for one day. But then you must shut it away in a safe place and never take it out again".
Thomas was so excited. He put the red bracelet on and ran out to show it to his friends. The day passed quickly and before he knew it, it was time to keep the bracelet safe. 
Thomas shut the bracelet away in a special box and put it in his mother's drawer. Every time he would look inside the drawer, he would remember that special day when he found the pretty red bracelet.

Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to play outside and get dirty. One day, her mother saw her and said, "Lily, you need to wash your hands before dinner."
Lily replied, "But Mama, I don't want to wash my hands. They are not dirty."
Her mother smiled and said, "I know, but it's important to wash our hands so we don't get sick. Plus, it's always good to be clean."
Lily thought about it for a moment and then said, "Okay, Mama. I will wash my hands." So, Lily went to the sink and washed her hands with soap and water until they were clean and shiny. Her mother smiled and said, "Good job, Lily. You're an original girl."

Lila and Sam were playing in the sand. They liked to pretend they were explorers in the desert. They had a big hat, a water bottle and a map.
"Look, Sam, the map says there is an oasis over there!" Lila said, pointing to a green spot on the paper.
"Let's go and see!" Sam said, excited. They got up and started to walk.
But the sun was very hot and the sand was very dry. They felt thirsty and tired. They wished they had a camel to ride.
"Maybe we should crawl, like snakes," Lila suggested. "It might be cooler and faster."
"OK, let's try," Sam agreed. They dropped to their knees and began to crawl on the sand.
They crawled and crawled, but the oasis seemed very far away. They wondered if it was real or just a picture.
"Are we there yet?" Sam asked, panting.
"I don't know," Lila said, squinting. "I think I see something green."
They crawled a little more, and then they saw it. It was an oasis, a small pool of water with some palm trees and grass. It looked like a paradise.
"Wow, we made it!" Lila exclaimed, smiling.
"Yay, we did it!" Sam cheered, clapping.
They ran to the water and splashed their faces. They drank some water and felt refreshed. They saw some brown dates hanging from the trees and picked some to eat. They felt happy and proud.
They decided to rest under the shade of the palms. They spread their hat on the ground and lay down.
"This is the best adventure ever," Lila said, cuddling with Sam.
"I agree," Sam said, closing his eyes. "You are the best explorer ever."
They fell asleep, dreaming of more adventures.
